  async function sendEventWithRetry(event, fingerprint) {
    for (let attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
      try {
        const result = await browser.runtime.sendMessage({
          type: "AI_COUNCIL_LIMIT_EVENT",
          event
        });

        if (result?.saved) {
          lastSent.set(fingerprint, Date.now());
          return true;
        }
      } catch {
        // Ignora erro temporário
      }

      if (attempt < MAX_RETRY_ATTEMPTS) {
        await delay(BASE_RETRY_DELAY_MS * attempt);
      }
    }

    return false;
  }

  async function evaluateAndReport(element, text) {
    const classification = classify(text);
    if (!classification) return;

    const fingerprint = `${source}:${classification.signal}`;
    const previous = lastSent.get(fingerprint);

    if (previous && Date.now() - previous < COOLDOWN_MS) {
      return;
    }

    if (inFlight.has(fingerprint)) {
      return;
    }

    inFlight.add(fingerprint);

    const event = {
      source,
      severity: classification.severity,
      signal: classification.signal,
      confidence: classification.confidence,
      message:
        classification.severity === "blocked"
          ? "Possível limite de utilização atingido."
          : "Possível aviso de proximidade do limite.",
      matchedText: text.slice(0, SELECTOR_TEXT_MAX),
      url: location.origin
    };

    try {
      await sendEventWithRetry(event, fingerprint);
    } finally {
      inFlight.delete(fingerprint);
    }
  }

  function inspectElement(element) {
    if (!isVisible(element)) return;
    if (isInsideConversation(element)) return;

    const text = normalizeText(element.innerText || element.textContent || "");
    if (!text) return;

    if (text.length <= SELECTOR_TEXT_MAX) {
      evaluateAndReport(element, text);
      return;
    }

    const childCandidates = element.querySelectorAll(
      "p, span, div, h1, h2, h3, h4, li"
    );

    for (const child of childCandidates) {
      if (!isVisible(child)) continue;
      if (isInsideConversation(child)) continue;

      const childText = normalizeText(
        child.innerText || child.textContent || ""
      );

      if (
        childText &&
        childText.length <= SELECTOR_TEXT_MAX &&
        child.children.length <= 4
      ) {
        evaluateAndReport(child, childText);
      }
    }
  }

  function scan() {
    const visited = new Set();

    for (const selector of SELECTORS) {
      const elements = document.querySelectorAll(selector);

      for (const element of elements) {
        if (visited.has(element)) continue;
        visited.add(element);
        inspectElement(element);
      }
    }
  }

  let scanScheduled = false;

  const observer = new MutationObserver(() => {
    if (scanScheduled) return;
    scanScheduled = true;

    setTimeout(() => {
      scanScheduled = false;
      scan();
    }, 500);
  });

  observer.observe(document.documentElement, {
    childList: true,
    subtree: true,
    characterData: true,
    attributes: true,
    attributeFilter: ["style", "class", "hidden", "aria-hidden"]
  });

  scan();

  // ============================================
  // 2. MOTOR 100% AUTOMATIZADO (ZERO INTERVENÇÃO HUMANA)
  // ============================================

  const STAGE_NAMES = {
    initial_response: "Análise Inicial",
    critique: "Debate e Crítica Cruzada",
    synthesis: "Síntese e Conclusão Final"
  };

  let currentPendingData = null;
  let autoPilotEnabled = true;

  let activeAutoTaskId = null;
  let autoTaskPhase = "idle";
  let baselineResponseCount = 0;
  let baselineLastText = "";
  let lastObservedText = "";
  let stableTicks = 0;

  function setWidgetStatus(text, color = "#e9ad54") {
    const statusEl = document.getElementById("ai-council-widget-status");
    if (statusEl) {
      statusEl.style.color = color;
      statusEl.textContent = text;
    }
  }

  function findChatInputBox() {
    if (source === "chatgpt") {
      return (
        document.querySelector('#prompt-textarea[contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector("#prompt-textarea") ||
        document.querySelector('div.ProseMirror[contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector("textarea")
      );
    }

    if (source === "claude") {
      return (
        document.querySelector('div.ProseMirror[contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector('fieldset [contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector("textarea")
      );
    }

    if (source === "gemini") {
      return (
        document.querySelector('rich-textarea div.ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector('div.ql-editor[contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector('rich-textarea [contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector('div[role="textbox"][contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector('[contenteditable="true"]') ||
        document.querySelector("textarea")
      );
    }

    return null;
  }

  // Injeção nativa no MAIN WORLD da página (via wrappedJSObject do Firefox)
  // Isso faz o React/ProseMirror do ChatGPT reconhecer o texto instantaneamente e ativar a setinha de enviar!
  function injectTextViaPageContext(inputEl, promptText) {
    try {
      const pageWin = window.wrappedJSObject || window;
      const rawEl = inputEl.wrappedJSObject || inputEl;

      rawEl.focus();

      // 1. Posiciona a seleção dentro do elemento no contexto da página
      const sel = pageWin.getSelection();
      const range = pageWin.document.createRange();
      range.selectNodeContents(rawEl);
      sel.removeAllRanges();
      sel.addRange(range);

      // 2. Cria DataTransfer e ClipboardEvent usando os construtores REAIS da página (sem Xray wrapper!)
      const dt = new pageWin.DataTransfer();
      dt.setData("text/plain", promptText);

      const pasteInit = cloneInto(
        {
          bubbles: true,
          cancelable: true
        },
        pageWin
      );
      pasteInit.clipboardData = dt;

      const pasteEv = new pageWin.ClipboardEvent("paste", pasteInit);
      rawEl.dispatchEvent(pasteEv);

      // 3. Se ainda estiver vazio após o paste nativo, usa execCommand da página
      const afterPaste = (inputEl.innerText || inputEl.textContent || "").trim();
      if (afterPaste.length < 15) {
        pageWin.document.execCommand("selectAll", false, null);
        pageWin.document.execCommand("insertText", false, promptText);
      }

      // 4. Se ainda estiver vazio (ex: janela não focada no SO), injeta no <p> e dispara beforeinput + input da página
      const afterExec = (inputEl.innerText || inputEl.textContent || "").trim();
      if (afterExec.length < 15) {
        let pNode = rawEl.querySelector("p");
        if (!pNode) {
          pNode = pageWin.document.createElement("p");
          rawEl.appendChild(pNode);
        }
        pNode.classList.remove("placeholder");
        pNode.removeAttribute("data-placeholder");
        pNode.textContent = promptText;

        const inputInit = cloneInto(
          {
            bubbles: true,
            cancelable: true,
            inputType: "insertText",
            data: promptText
          },
          pageWin
        );
        rawEl.dispatchEvent(new pageWin.InputEvent("beforeinput", inputInit));
        rawEl.dispatchEvent(new pageWin.InputEvent("input", inputInit));
      }

      const finalCheck = (inputEl.innerText || inputEl.textContent || "").trim();
      return finalCheck.length >= 15;
    } catch (err) {
      console.warn("[AI Council] Fallback de injeção:", err);
      return false;
    }
  }

  function findSendButton() {
    if (source === "chatgpt") {
      const directBtn =
        document.querySelector('button[data-testid="send-button"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Enviar prompt"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Enviar mensagem"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Send prompt"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Send message"]');

      if (directBtn) return directBtn;

      const inputEl = findChatInputBox();
      if (inputEl) {
        const container = inputEl.closest("form") || inputEl.parentElement?.parentElement;
        if (container) {
          // Procura qualquer botão de submit habilitado que NÃO seja o botão de voz (speech) nem de anexo
          const buttons = Array.from(container.querySelectorAll("button:not([disabled])"));
          for (let i = buttons.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
            const b = buttons[i];
            const testId = (b.getAttribute("data-testid") || "").toLowerCase();
            const label = (b.getAttribute("aria-label") || "").toLowerCase();
            if (
              testId.includes("speech") ||
              testId.includes("voice") ||
              label.includes("voz") ||
              label.includes("voice") ||
              label.includes("anexar") ||
              label.includes("attach") ||
              label.includes("pensar") ||
              label.includes("think") ||
              label.includes("pesquisar") ||
              label.includes("search")
            ) {
              continue;
            }
            if (testId.includes("send") || b.type === "submit") {
              return b;
            }
          }
        }
      }
      return null;
    }

    if (source === "claude") {
      return (
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Send Message"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Send message"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Enviar"]') ||
        document.querySelector('fieldset button[type="button"]:not([disabled])')
      );
    }

    if (source === "gemini") {
      return (
        document.querySelector("button.send-button") ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Send message"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Enviar mensagem"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Enviar"]') ||
        document.querySelector(".send-button-container button")
      );
    }

    return null;
  }

  async function triggerSendAutomatically() {
    const pageWin = window.wrappedJSObject || window;

    // 1. Aguarda até 2.5s pelo botão de enviar aparecer e clica nele no contexto da página
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
      const sendBtn = findSendButton();
      if (
        sendBtn &&
        !sendBtn.disabled &&
        sendBtn.getAttribute("aria-disabled") !== "true"
      ) {
        const rawBtn = sendBtn.wrappedJSObject || sendBtn;
        rawBtn.click();
        return true;
      }
      await delay(250);
    }

    // 2. Se o botão não foi clicado (ou o ChatGPT espera Enter no ProseMirror), dispara Enter nativo da página!
    const inputEl = findChatInputBox();
    if (inputEl) {
      try {
        const rawEl = inputEl.wrappedJSObject || inputEl;
        rawEl.focus();

        const keyInit = cloneInto(
          {
            key: "Enter",
            code: "Enter",
            keyCode: 13,
            which: 13,
            bubbles: true,
            cancelable: true
          },
          pageWin
        );

        rawEl.dispatchEvent(new pageWin.KeyboardEvent("keydown", keyInit));
        rawEl.dispatchEvent(new pageWin.KeyboardEvent("keypress", keyInit));
        rawEl.dispatchEvent(new pageWin.KeyboardEvent("keyup", keyInit));

        await delay(300);

        // Verifica se a caixa esvaziou (sinal de que o Enter enviou a mensagem!)
        const remaining = (inputEl.innerText || inputEl.textContent || "").trim();
        if (remaining.length < 15) {
          return true;
        }

        // Último recurso: requestSubmit() direto no <form> do ChatGPT
        const form = inputEl.closest("form");
        if (form) {
          const rawForm = form.wrappedJSObject || form;
          if (typeof rawForm.requestSubmit === "function") {
            rawForm.requestSubmit();
            return true;
          }
        }
      } catch (err) {
        console.warn("[AI Council] Erro ao disparar Enter nativo:", err);
      }
    }

    return false;
  }

  function isAIStillGenerating() {
    if (source === "chatgpt") {
      const stopBtn =
        document.querySelector('button[data-testid="stop-button"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Stop streaming"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Stop generating"]');
      return Boolean(stopBtn && isVisible(stopBtn));
    }

    if (source === "claude") {
      const streamingEl = document.querySelector('[data-is-streaming="true"]');
      const stopBtn =
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Stop"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Parar"]');
      return Boolean(streamingEl || (stopBtn && isVisible(stopBtn)));
    }

    if (source === "gemini") {
      const stopBtn =
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Stop"]') ||
        document.querySelector('button[aria-label*="Parar"]') ||
        document.querySelector("button.stop");
      return Boolean(stopBtn && isVisible(stopBtn));
    }

    return false;
  }

  function isPromptEcho(text) {
    return (
      text.includes("REGRA ABSOLUTA DE FORMATO (BLOCO MARKDOWN ÚNICO):") ||
      text.includes("SUA MISSÃO NESTA RODADA 1:") ||
      text.includes("SUA MISSÃO FINAL COMO RELATOR") ||
      text.includes("TAREFA (RODADA 1 — PROPOSTA E RESPOSTA CONCRETA):") ||
      text.includes("REGRAS DE FORMATAÇÃO DA SUA RESPOSTA:")
    );
  }

  function getAssistantResponseElements() {
    if (source === "chatgpt") {
      const allBlocks = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll(
          'pre, code, .cm-content, [data-message-author-role="assistant"], .markdown'
        )
      ).filter((el) => {
        if (el.closest("#ai-council-assistant-widget")) return false;
        if (el.closest("form")) return false;
        if (el.closest('[data-message-author-role="user"]')) return false;

        const txt = (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").trim();
        if (txt.length < 30) return false;
        if (isPromptEcho(txt)) return false;

        return true;
      });

      return allBlocks.filter(
        (el) => !allBlocks.some((other) => other !== el && other.contains(el))
      );
    }

    if (source === "claude") {
      const rawCandidates = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll(
          '.font-claude-response, .font-claude-message, [data-is-streaming="false"], div.standard-markdown'
        )
      ).filter((el) => !el.closest('[data-testid="user-message"]'));

      const topLevel = rawCandidates.filter(
        (el) =>
          !rawCandidates.some((other) => other !== el && other.contains(el))
      );

      return topLevel.filter((el) => {
        if (el.closest("#ai-council-assistant-widget")) return false;
        const txt = (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").trim();
        return txt.length > 20 && !isPromptEcho(txt);
      });
    }

    if (source === "gemini") {
      const rawCandidates = Array.from(
        document.querySelectorAll(
          "model-response message-content, model-response .markdown, model-response"
        )
      );

      const topLevel = rawCandidates.filter(
        (el) =>
          !rawCandidates.some((other) => other !== el && other.contains(el))
      );

      return topLevel.filter((el) => {
        if (el.closest("#ai-council-assistant-widget")) return false;
        const txt = (el.innerText || el.textContent || "").trim();
        return txt.length > 20 && !isPromptEcho(txt);
      });
    }

    return [];
  }

  function cleanExtractedText(raw) {
    return (raw || "")
      .replace(/^<\/>\s*Markdown\s*\n?/i, "")
      .replace(/^Markdown\s*\n/i, "")
      .replace(/^~~~~+markdown\s*/i, "")
      .replace(/^~~~+markdown\s*/i, "")
      .replace(/^```+markdown\s*/i, "")
      .replace(/~~~~+\s*$/i, "")
      .replace(/#*\s*\[FIM_DA_RESPOSTA\]/gi, "")
      .replace(/\n{3,}/g, "\n\n")
      .trim();
  }

  function convertElementToCleanMarkdown(rootEl) {
    if (!rootEl) return null;

    const innerCodeWithEnd = Array.from(
      rootEl.querySelectorAll("code, .cm-content, pre")
    ).find((node) =>
      /\[FIM_DA_RESPOSTA\]/i.test(node.innerText || node.textContent || "")
    );

    if (innerCodeWithEnd) {
      const cleanedInner = cleanExtractedText(
        innerCodeWithEnd.innerText || innerCodeWithEnd.textContent || ""
      );
      if (cleanedInner.length > 25) {
        return cleanedInner;
      }
    }

    const clone = rootEl.cloneNode(true);

    const uiButtons = clone.querySelectorAll(
      'button, svg, [role="toolbar"], [aria-label*="Copy"], [aria-label*="Copiar"]'
    );
    for (const btn of uiButtons) {
      if (!btn.querySelector("code, .cm-content")) {
        btn.remove();
      }
    }

    const preElements = clone.querySelectorAll("pre");
    for (const pre of preElements) {
      const codeEl = pre.querySelector("code, .cm-content");
      const codeContent = ((codeEl || pre).textContent || "").trim();
      const classAttr = (codeEl?.className || pre.className || "").toLowerCase();
      const langMatch = classAttr.match(/language-([a-z0-9_+-]+)/);
      const lang =
        langMatch && langMatch[1] !== "markdown" ? langMatch[1] : "";

      if (lang) {
        const fenced = `\n\`\`\`${lang}\n${codeContent}\n\`\`\`\n`;
        pre.replaceWith(document.createTextNode(fenced));
      } else {
        pre.replaceWith(document.createTextNode(`\n${codeContent}\n`));
      }
    }

    const headings = clone.querySelectorAll("h1, h2, h3, h4");
    for (const h of headings) {
      const level = Number(h.tagName.slice(1)) || 2;
      h.textContent = `\n${"#".repeat(level)} ${(h.textContent || "").trim()}\n`;
    }

    const listItems = clone.querySelectorAll("li");
    for (const li of listItems) {
      if (!li.querySelector("li")) {
        li.textContent = `\n- ${(li.textContent || "").trim()}`;
      }
    }

    const cleaned = cleanExtractedText(clone.innerText || clone.textContent || "");
    return cleaned.length > 25 ? cleaned : null;
  }

  function extractLastAssistantResponse() {
    const validElements = getAssistantResponseElements();
    if (validElements.length === 0) return null;
    return convertElementToCleanMarkdown(
      validElements[validElements.length - 1]
    );
  }

  async function submitCapturedResponseToCouncil(content) {
    if (!currentPendingData?.task?.id || !currentPendingData?.debateId) {
      return false;
    }

    autoTaskPhase = "submitting";
    setWidgetStatus(
      "🤖 Enviando resposta em Markdown ao AI Council...",
      "#8ca5ff"
    );

    try {
      const res = await browser.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: "AI_COUNCIL_SUBMIT_TASK_RESPONSE",
        payload: {
          debateId: currentPendingData.debateId,
          taskId: currentPendingData.task.id,
          content
        }
      });

      if (res?.ok) {
        autoTaskPhase = "done";
        setWidgetStatus(
          "✔ Resposta salva no AI Council com sucesso!",
          "#39c98a"
        );
        setTimeout(() => {
          pollPendingTask();
        }, 1000);
        return true;
      } else {
        autoTaskPhase = "idle";
        setWidgetStatus(res?.error || "Erro ao enviar resposta.", "#ed6674");
        return false;
      }
    } catch {
      autoTaskPhase = "idle";
      setWidgetStatus("Falha de comunicação ao enviar resposta.", "#ed6674");
      return false;
    }
  }

  async function startAutoPilotForCurrentTask() {
    if (!autoPilotEnabled || !currentPendingData?.task) return;

    const task = currentPendingData.task;

    if (activeAutoTaskId === task.id && autoTaskPhase !== "idle") {
      return;
    }

    activeAutoTaskId = task.id;

    const currentElements = getAssistantResponseElements();
    if (currentElements.length > 0) {
      const lastEl = currentElements[currentElements.length - 1];
      const lastTxt = (lastEl.innerText || lastEl.textContent || "").trim();
      if (
        /\[FIM_DA_RESPOSTA\]/i.test(lastTxt) &&
        lastTxt !== baselineLastText
      ) {
        const readyMd = convertElementToCleanMarkdown(lastEl);
        if (readyMd && readyMd.length > 30) {
          baselineLastText = lastTxt;
          await submitCapturedResponseToCouncil(readyMd);
          return;
        }
      }
    }

    autoTaskPhase = "injecting";

    baselineResponseCount = currentElements.length;
    baselineLastText =
      currentElements.length > 0
        ? (
            currentElements[currentElements.length - 1].innerText ||
            currentElements[currentElements.length - 1].textContent ||
            ""
          ).trim()
        : "";
    lastObservedText = "";
    stableTicks = 0;

    setWidgetStatus("🤖 Auto-Pilot: injetando e enviando pergunta...", "#8ca5ff");

    await delay(400);

    const inputEl = findChatInputBox();
    if (!inputEl) {
      autoTaskPhase = "idle";
      return;
    }

    const inserted = injectTextViaPageContext(inputEl, task.prompt);
    if (!inserted) {
      autoTaskPhase = "idle";
      return;
    }

    const sent = await triggerSendAutomatically();
    if (sent) {
      setWidgetStatus(
        "🤖 Pergunta enviada automaticamente! Aguardando resposta...",
        "#e9ad54"
      );
      autoTaskPhase = "waiting_response";
    } else {
      // Se não enviou na primeira tentativa, volta para idle para tentar no próximo ciclo de 3s!
      autoTaskPhase = "idle";
      activeAutoTaskId = null;
    }
  }

  async function checkAutoPilotResponseProgress() {
    if (
      !autoPilotEnabled ||
      autoTaskPhase !== "waiting_response" ||
      !currentPendingData?.task ||
      activeAutoTaskId !== currentPendingData.task.id
    ) {
      return;
    }

    const elements = getAssistantResponseElements();
    if (elements.length === 0) return;

    const latestEl = elements[elements.length - 1];
    const latestRawText = (latestEl.innerText || latestEl.textContent || "").trim();

    const hasExplicitEndMarker = /\[FIM_DA_RESPOSTA\]/i.test(latestRawText);

    if (hasExplicitEndMarker && latestRawText !== baselineLastText) {
      const cleanMarkdown = convertElementToCleanMarkdown(latestEl);
      if (cleanMarkdown && cleanMarkdown.length > 30) {
        baselineLastText = latestRawText;
        await submitCapturedResponseToCouncil(cleanMarkdown);
        return;
      }
    }

    const isNewResponse =
      elements.length > baselineResponseCount ||
      (latestRawText !== baselineLastText && latestRawText.length > 35);

    if (!isNewResponse) {
      return;
    }

    if (isAIStillGenerating()) {
      stableTicks = 0;
      lastObservedText = latestRawText;
      setWidgetStatus(
        `🤖 IA gerando resposta (${latestRawText.length} caracteres)...`,
        "#e9ad54"
      );
      return;
    }

    if (latestRawText === lastObservedText && latestRawText.length > 35) {
      stableTicks += 1;
      setWidgetStatus(
        `🤖 Confirmando fim da resposta (${Math.min(stableTicks, 3)}/3)...`,
        "#8ca5ff"
      );
    } else {
      stableTicks = 0;
      lastObservedText = latestRawText;
      return;
    }

    if (stableTicks >= 3) {
      const cleanMarkdown = convertElementToCleanMarkdown(latestEl);
      if (cleanMarkdown && cleanMarkdown.length > 30) {
        baselineLastText = latestRawText;
        await submitCapturedResponseToCouncil(cleanMarkdown);
      }
    }
  }

  function ensureWidgetElement() {
    let widget = document.getElementById("ai-council-assistant-widget");
    if (widget) return widget;

    widget = document.createElement("div");
    widget.id = "ai-council-assistant-widget";
    widget.style.cssText = [
      "position: fixed",
      "bottom: 20px",
      "right: 20px",
      "z-index: 2147483647",
      "width: 340px",
      "background: #131a26",
      "border: 1px solid #6385ff",
      "border-radius: 12px",
      "padding: 14px",
      "color: #edf1fa",
      "font-family: Inter, Segoe UI, Arial, sans-serif",
      "font-size: 12px",
      "box-shadow: 0 10px 30px rgba(0,0,0,0.65)",
      "pointer-events: auto",
      "display: none"
    ].join(";");

    const header = document.createElement("div");
    header.style.cssText =
      "display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;margin-bottom:8px;font-weight:700;color:#8ca5ff;";

    const headerTitle = document.createElement("span");
    headerTitle.textContent = "⚖ AI COUNCIL";

    const autoToggleBtn = document.createElement("button");
    autoToggleBtn.type = "button";
    autoToggleBtn.style.cssText = [
      "padding: 3px 8px",
      "border-radius: 12px",
      "border: 1px solid rgba(57, 201, 138, 0.5)",
      "background: rgba(57, 201, 138, 0.15)",
      "color: #39c98a",
      "font-size: 10px",
      "font-weight: 700",
      "cursor: pointer"
    ].join(";");
    autoToggleBtn.textContent = "🤖 Auto-Pilot: ON";

    autoToggleBtn.addEventListener("click", (e) => {
      e.stopPropagation();
      autoPilotEnabled = !autoPilotEnabled;
      if (autoPilotEnabled) {
        autoToggleBtn.textContent = "🤖 Auto-Pilot: ON";
        autoToggleBtn.style.color = "#39c98a";
        if (currentPendingData?.task) {
          autoTaskPhase = "idle";
          activeAutoTaskId = null;
          startAutoPilotForCurrentTask();
        }
      } else {
        autoToggleBtn.textContent = "🤖 Auto-Pilot: OFF";
        autoToggleBtn.style.color = "#e9ad54";
        setWidgetStatus("Piloto automático pausado.", "#9ba8bb");
      }
    });

    header.append(headerTitle, autoToggleBtn);

    const info = document.createElement("div");
    info.id = "ai-council-widget-info";
    info.style.cssText =
      "color:#9ba8bb;font-size:11px;line-height:1.4;margin-bottom:10px;";

    const btnInsert = document.createElement("button");
    btnInsert.type = "button";
    btnInsert.textContent = "1. Reenviar / Inserir Pergunta na IA";
    btnInsert.style.cssText = [
      "width: 100%",
      "padding: 8px 10px",
      "margin-bottom: 6px",
      "background: #6385ff",
      "color: #fff",
      "border: none",
      "border-radius: 8px",
      "font-weight: 600",
      "cursor: pointer"
    ].join(";");

    const btnCapture = document.createElement("button");
    btnCapture.type = "button";
    btnCapture.textContent = "2. Forçar Captura da Última Resposta";
    btnCapture.style.cssText = [
      "width: 100%",

      "color: #39c98a",
      "border: 1px solid rgba(57, 201, 138, 0.45)",

      "font-weight: 600",
      "cursor: pointer"

      if (!lastResponse) {
        setWidgetStatus(
          "Ainda não encontrei uma resposta válida da IA nesta página.",
          "#ed6674"
        );
        return;
      }

      btnCapture.disabled = true;
      await submitCapturedResponseToCouncil(lastResponse);
      btnCapture.disabled = false;
    });

    widget.append(header, info, btnInsert, btnCapture, statusMsg);
    document.body.appendChild(widget);
    return widget;
  }

  async function pollPendingTask() {
    try {
      const response = await browser.runtime.sendMessage({
        type: "AI_COUNCIL_GET_PENDING_TASK",
        source
      });

      const widget = ensureWidgetElement();
      const infoEl = document.getElementById("ai-council-widget-info");

      if (!response?.ok || !response.task) {
        currentPendingData = null;
        activeAutoTaskId = null;
        autoTaskPhase = "idle";
        widget.style.display = "none";
        return;
      }

      const isNewTask =
        !currentPendingData ||
        currentPendingData.task?.id !== response.task.id;

      currentPendingData = response;
      widget.style.display = "block";

      const stageLabel =
        STAGE_NAMES[response.task.stage] || response.task.stage;

      if (infoEl) {
        infoEl.textContent = `Debate: "${response.debateTitle}" • Rodada ${response.currentRound}/${response.totalRounds} (${stageLabel})`;
      }

      if (isNewTask || autoTaskPhase === "idle") {
        startAutoPilotForCurrentTask();
      }
    } catch {
      // Silencioso se o servidor estiver desligado
    }
  }

  setInterval(pollPendingTask, 3000);
  setInterval(checkAutoPilotResponseProgress, 1500);
  setTimeout(pollPendingTask, 1000);
})();

ARQUIVO: ./LEIA-ME.md

# AI Council v2 — conselho de IAs automático e gratuito

O servidor agora chama **Gemini, Groq e OpenRouter** sozinho pelas APIs gratuitas.
Você cria o debate no painel e ele roda até a síntese final. ChatGPT e Claude ficam
como assentos **manuais opcionais** (você cola a resposta), sem automatizar a interface web.

## 1. Instalar (uma vez)

1. **Faça uma cópia da pasta do projeto** (backup).
2. Extraia este zip **dentro da pasta do projeto** e aceite substituir os arquivos.
3. Abra o `.env` e confira se tem as 4 linhas (veja `.env.example`):
   `GEMINI_API_KEY`, `GROQ_API_KEY`, `OPENROUTER_API_KEY`, `MONITOR_TOKEN`.
4. **Remova a extensão do Firefox** (`about:addons` → AI Council Usage Monitor → Remover).
   Ela automatizava o ChatGPT/Claude pela interface web e não é mais necessária.
   (Por segurança, o servidor já não entrega mais tarefas pendentes a ela.)

No PowerShell, dentro da pasta do projeto (use `.cmd` para evitar o bloqueio de scripts):

```
npm.cmd run test:providers:dry
npm.cmd run test:providers
npm.cmd run monitor
```

- `test:providers:dry` só confere a configuração (não chama nenhuma API).
- `test:providers` faz **1 chamada mínima por provedor** para validar as chaves e os modelos.
- `monitor` sobe o servidor. Abra **http://127.0.0.1:4317**.

## 2. Como usar

1. No painel, em **Centro de debates**, escreva o título e o problema.
2. Escolha o **Tipo de trabalho** (muda o papel de cada IA):
   - **Backend / código**: Gemini propõe, Groq ataca bugs e segurança, OpenRouter simplifica.
   - **Frontend (sem cara de IA)**: o OpenRouter revisa UX e estética com regras contra o visual genérico de IA.
3. Deixe Gemini, Groq e OpenRouter marcados. Marque ChatGPT/Claude só se quiser colar respostas deles.
4. Clique em **Criar e Iniciar Debate**. O resto é automático.
5. No fim, copie a **Síntese e Conclusão** em Markdown.

## 3. Proteções contra gasto

- Nenhum cartão e nenhum crédito cadastrado: falha de API nunca vira cobrança.
- O OpenRouter **só aceita modelos terminando em `:free`**; qualquer outro é recusado pelo código.
- Contador diário local (`data/usage.json`) que **para antes** do limite (90% por padrão).
- Sem retentativas escondidas: máximo de 2 tentativas por chamada (3 no OpenRouter), contadas no limite diário.
- Limite por minuto respeitado com espera automática (importante na Groq: 8.000 tokens/min).
- Erro 429 ou limite diário **pausa o debate** com o progresso salvo; clique em **Retomar** quando liberar.
- Respostas já recebidas nunca se perdem, mesmo que você pause no meio.

## 4. Economia de tokens

- As regras de formato ficam em um único prompt de sistema curto.
- Entre rodadas, cada resposta anterior é reduzida (início + fim) antes de ser reenviada.
- Teto de tokens por etapa (1.100 nas rodadas, 1.600 na síntese). Máximo de 3 rodadas.
- Gemini 2.5 Flash roda com "thinking" desligado (evita gastar tokens pensando).
- Não existe mais o truque do `~~~~markdown` nem o `[FIM_DA_RESPOSTA]`.

## 5. Ajustes opcionais no `.env`

Os padrões já funcionam. Para trocar modelos ou limites, veja `.env.example`.
Os limites do Gemini gratuito não são mais publicados pelo Google: confira no console do
AI Studio e ajuste `GEMINI_RPM` / `GEMINI_RPD` se precisar.

## 6. Observações

- **Privacidade:** na camada gratuita do Gemini, as requisições podem ser usadas pelo Google
  para melhorar produtos. Não envie segredos, chaves ou código sensível.
- Debates **antigos** continuam manuais (o runner só automatiza os criados por esta versão).
- Pode apagar a pasta `extension/` do projeto.
- Pasta `data/` (debates e uso diário) é criada sozinha; não precisa mexer.

## 7. Problemas comuns

| Sintoma | O que fazer |
|---|---|
| Provedor "NÃO PRONTO" | Falta a chave no `.env` ou o modelo do OpenRouter não termina em `:free`. |
| Falha `model` no teste | O nome do modelo mudou. Rode `npm.cmd run list-models` e troque no `.env`. |
| Debate "Pausado (Limite)" | Acabou a cota do dia ou do minuto. Espere e clique em Retomar. |
| Debate "Pausado (Erro no Provedor)" | Leia a mensagem no banner, corrija (chave/modelo) e clique em Retomar. |

// ============================================================================
// FORMATAÇÃO DE DATAS E CRONÔMETROS DE ALTA PRECISÃO
// ============================================================================

function formatDate(value) {
  if (!value) return "Data não informada";
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "Data não informada";
  return date.toLocaleString("pt-BR");
}

function formatShortTime(value) {
  if (!value) return "";
  const date = new Date(value);
  if (Number.isNaN(date.getTime())) return "";
  return date.toLocaleTimeString("pt-BR", { hour: "2-digit", minute: "2-digit" });
}

function formatStopwatch(seconds) {
  const safe = Math.max(0, Number(seconds) || 0);
  const mins = Math.floor(safe / 60);
  const rem = safe - mins * 60;
  const secsInt = Math.floor(rem);
  const tenths = Math.floor((rem - secsInt) * 10);
  const mm = String(mins).padStart(2, "0");
  const ss = String(secsInt).padStart(2, "0");
  return `${mm}:${ss}.${tenths}s`;
}

function formatSecondsCompact(seconds) {
  const safe = Math.max(0.1, Number(seconds) || 0.1);
  if (safe >= 60) {
    const mins = Math.floor(safe / 60);
    const rem = (safe - mins * 60).toFixed(1);
    return `${mins}m ${rem}s`;
  }
  return `${safe.toFixed(1)}s`;
}

function formatSecondsPadded(seconds) {
  const safe = Math.max(0.1, Number(seconds) || 0.1);
  if (safe < 10) {
    return `0${safe.toFixed(1)}s`;
  }
  return `${safe.toFixed(1)}s`;
}

function getTaskStartMs(task, debate) {
  if (!task) return Date.now();
  if (localTaskStartMs.has(task.id)) {
    return localTaskStartMs.get(task.id);
  }

  const createdMs = Date.parse(task.createdAt || "");
  const updatedMs = Date.parse(debate?.updatedAt || "");
  const now = Date.now();

  let startMs = !Number.isNaN(createdMs) ? createdMs : now;

  // Se a tarefa foi retomada após uma pausa longa, ancora no updatedAt da retomada
  if (!Number.isNaN(updatedMs) && updatedMs > startMs + 120_000 && task.status === "pending") {
    startMs = updatedMs;
  }

  if (startMs > now) {
    startMs = now;
  }

  localTaskStartMs.set(task.id, startMs);
  return startMs;
}

function getCompletedTaskDurationSec(task, matchingResponse) {
  const startMs = Date.parse(task?.createdAt || "");
  const endMs = Date.parse(task?.completedAt || matchingResponse?.submittedAt || "");
  if (!Number.isNaN(startMs) && !Number.isNaN(endMs) && endMs >= startMs) {
    const diffSec = (endMs - startMs) / 1000;
    // Se uma tarefa foi pausada por horas, limita ou exibe o tempo real razoável
    return Math.max(0.1, diffSec);
  }
  return null;
}

function getDebateTotalDurationSec(debate) {
  if (!debate) return null;
  // Soma as durações das etapas ou diferença entre createdAt e completedAt
  const startMs = Date.parse(debate.createdAt || "");
  const endMs = Date.parse(
    debate.completedAt ||
      (debate.responses && debate.responses.length > 0
        ? debate.responses[debate.responses.length - 1].submittedAt
        : "")
  );

  if (!Number.isNaN(startMs) && !Number.isNaN(endMs) && endMs >= startMs) {
    return Math.max(0.1, (endMs - startMs) / 1000);
  }
  return null;
}

// ============================================================================
// RENDERIZADOR MARKDOWN SEGURO + BLOCOS DE CÓDIGO COM BOTÃO DE COPIAR
// ============================================================================

function escapeHtml(raw) {
  return String(raw || "")
    .replace(/&/g, "&amp;")
    .replace(/</g, "&lt;")
    .replace(/>/g, "&gt;")
    .replace(/"/g, "&quot;")
    .replace(/'/g, "&#39;");
}

function formatInlineMarkdown(escapedLine) {
  return escapedLine
    .replace(/`([^`]+)`/g, "<code>$1</code>")
    .replace(/\*\*([^*]+)\*\*/g, "<strong>$1</strong>")
    .replace(/\*([^*]+)\*/g, "<em>$1</em>");
}

function buildMarkdownDom(markdownText) {
  const container = document.createElement("div");
  container.className = "markdown-content";

  const raw = String(markdownText || "").replace(/\r\n/g, "\n").trim();
  if (!raw) return container;

  // Divide por blocos de código cercados por ```
  const segments = [];
  const fenceRegex = /```([a-zA-Z0-9_-]*)\n([\s\S]*?)```/g;
  let lastIndex = 0;
  let match;

  while ((match = fenceRegex.exec(raw)) !== null) {
    if (match.index > lastIndex) {
      segments.push({
        type: "prose",
        content: raw.slice(lastIndex, match.index)
      });
    }
    segments.push({
      type: "code",
      lang: (match[1] || "code").trim(),
      content: match[2].replace(/\n$/, "")
    });
    lastIndex = fenceRegex.lastIndex;
  }

  if (lastIndex < raw.length) {
    segments.push({
      type: "prose",
      content: raw.slice(lastIndex)
    });
  }

  for (const seg of segments) {
    if (seg.type === "code") {
      const codeWrapper = document.createElement("div");
      codeWrapper.className = "code-block-wrapper";

      const codeHeader = document.createElement("div");
      codeHeader.className = "code-block-header";

      const langSpan = document.createElement("span");
      langSpan.className = "code-lang-label";
      langSpan.textContent = seg.lang || "código";

      const copyCodeBtn = document.createElement("button");
      copyCodeBtn.type = "button";
      copyCodeBtn.className = "btn-copy-code";
      copyCodeBtn.innerHTML = `${SVG_ICONS.clipboard}<span>Copiar código</span>`;
      copyCodeBtn.addEventListener("click", async () => {
        try {
          await navigator.clipboard.writeText(seg.content);
          copyCodeBtn.innerHTML = `${SVG_ICONS.check}<span>Copiado</span>`;
          setTimeout(() => {
            copyCodeBtn.innerHTML = `${SVG_ICONS.clipboard}<span>Copiar código</span>`;
          }, 1800);
        } catch {
          copyCodeBtn.textContent = "Erro ao copiar";
        }
      });

      codeHeader.append(langSpan, copyCodeBtn);

      const pre = document.createElement("pre");
      pre.className = "code-block-pre";
      const codeEl = document.createElement("code");
      codeEl.textContent = seg.content;
      pre.appendChild(codeEl);

      codeWrapper.append(codeHeader, pre);
      container.appendChild(codeWrapper);
      continue;
    }

    // Processa linhas de texto / listas / tabelas / títulos
    const lines = seg.content.split("\n");
    let i = 0;

    while (i < lines.length) {
      const line = lines[i];
      const trimmed = line.trim();

      if (!trimmed) {
        i++;
        continue;
      }

      // Linha horizontal
      if (/^---+$/.test(trimmed) || /^\*\*\*+$/.test(trimmed)) {
        container.appendChild(document.createElement("hr"));
        i++;
        continue;
      }

      // Headings
      const headingMatch = trimmed.match(/^(#{1,4})\s+(.+)$/);
      if (headingMatch) {
        const level = Math.min(4, headingMatch[1].length);
        const h = document.createElement(`h${level}`);
        h.innerHTML = formatInlineMarkdown(escapeHtml(headingMatch[2]));
        container.appendChild(h);
        i++;
        continue;
      }

      // Tabela Markdown
      if (
        trimmed.startsWith("|") &&
        i + 1 < lines.length &&
        /^\|\s*[-:]+/.test(lines[i + 1].trim())
      ) {
        const tableWrap = document.createElement("div");
        tableWrap.className = "md-table-wrap";
        const table = document.createElement("table");
        table.className = "md-table";

        const parseRow = (rowStr) =>
          rowStr
            .trim()
            .replace(/^\|/, "")
            .replace(/\|$/, "")
            .split("|")
            .map((c) => c.trim());

        const headers = parseRow(trimmed);
        const thead = document.createElement("thead");
        const trHead = document.createElement("tr");
        for (const hText of headers) {
          const th = document.createElement("th");
          th.innerHTML = formatInlineMarkdown(escapeHtml(hText));
          trHead.appendChild(th);
        }
        thead.appendChild(trHead);
        table.appendChild(thead);

        i += 2; // Pula cabeçalho e linha separadora
        const tbody = document.createElement("tbody");
        while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim().startsWith("|")) {
          const cells = parseRow(lines[i]);
          const tr = document.createElement("tr");
          for (const cText of cells) {
            const td = document.createElement("td");
            td.innerHTML = formatInlineMarkdown(escapeHtml(cText));
            tr.appendChild(td);
          }
          tbody.appendChild(tr);
          i++;
        }
        table.appendChild(tbody);
        tableWrap.appendChild(table);
        container.appendChild(tableWrap);
        continue;
      }

      // Lista não ordenada
      if (/^[-*]\s+/.test(trimmed)) {
        const ul = document.createElement("ul");
        while (i < lines.length && /^[-*]\s+/.test(lines[i].trim())) {
          const itemText = lines[i].trim().replace(/^[-*]\s+/, "");
          const li = document.createElement("li");
          li.innerHTML = formatInlineMarkdown(escapeHtml(itemText));
          ul.appendChild(li);
          i++;
        }
        container.appendChild(ul);
        continue;
      }

      // Lista ordenada
      if (/^\d+\.\s+/.test(trimmed)) {
        const ol = document.createElement("ol");
        while (i < lines.length && /^\d+\.\s+/.test(lines[i].trim())) {
          const itemText = lines[i].trim().replace(/^\d+\.\s+/, "");
          const li = document.createElement("li");
          li.innerHTML = formatInlineMarkdown(escapeHtml(itemText));
          ol.appendChild(li);
          i++;
        }
        container.appendChild(ol);
        continue;
      }

      // Blockquote
      if (trimmed.startsWith(">")) {
        const bq = document.createElement("blockquote");
        const quoteLines = [];
        while (i < lines.length && lines[i].trim().startsWith(">")) {
          quoteLines.push(lines[i].trim().replace(/^>\s?/, ""));
          i++;
        }
        bq.innerHTML = formatInlineMarkdown(escapeHtml(quoteLines.join(" ")));
        container.appendChild(bq);
        continue;
      }

      // Parágrafo comum
      const paraLines = [];
      while (
        i < lines.length &&
        lines[i].trim() !== "" &&
        !/^(#{1,4}\s|[-*]\s|\d+\.\s|---|\*\*\*|\||>)/.test(lines[i].trim())
      ) {
        paraLines.push(lines[i].trim());
        i++;
      }
      if (paraLines.length > 0) {
        const p = document.createElement("p");
        p.innerHTML = formatInlineMarkdown(escapeHtml(paraLines.join(" ")));
        container.appendChild(p);
      } else {
        i++;
      }
    }
  }

  return container;
}

// ============================================================================
// UTILITÁRIOS DE EVENTOS E MONITORAMENTO
// ============================================================================

function getEventDate(event) {
  if (!event || typeof event !== "object") return null;
  return (
    event.observedAt ||
    event.timestamp ||
    event.detectedAt ||
    event.createdAt ||
    event.date ||
    event.time ||
    null
  );
}

function getEventTimestampMs(event) {
  const dateValue = getEventDate(event);
  if (!dateValue) return 0;
  const parsed = Date.parse(dateValue);
  return Number.isNaN(parsed) ? 0 : parsed;
}

function sortEventsDescending(events) {
  if (!Array.isArray(events)) return [];
  return [...events].sort((a, b) => getEventTimestampMs(b) - getEventTimestampMs(a));
}

function getEventMessage(event) {
  return (
    event.message ||
    event.text ||
    event.description ||
    event.notice ||
    "Aviso detectado na plataforma."
  );
}

function getEventSeverity(event) {
  return String(event?.severity || "").toLowerCase().trim();
}

function getEventSignal(event) {
  return String(
    event?.signal || event?.type || event?.status || event?.eventType || ""
  )
    .toLowerCase()
    .trim();
}

function getPlatform(event) {
  return String(event?.platform || event?.source || "").toLowerCase().trim();
}

function getAvailability(event) {
  const severity = getEventSeverity(event);
  const signal = getEventSignal(event);

  if (severity === "blocked" || signal === "usage_limit_reached") {
    return {
      state: "BLOCKED",
      label: "Limite atingido",
      badgeClass: "blocked",
      className: "offline"
    };
  }

  if (severity === "warning" || signal === "approaching_usage_limit") {
    return {
      state: "WARNING",
      label: "Limite próximo",
      badgeClass: "warning",
      className: "checking"
    };
  }

  return {
    state: "UNKNOWN",
    label: "Desconhecida",
    badgeClass: "unknown",
    className: "checking"
  };
}

function isRecent(event) {
  const timestampMs = getEventTimestampMs(event);
  if (!timestampMs) return false;
  const age = Date.now() - timestampMs;
  return age >= 0 && age <= RECENT_WINDOW_MS;
}

function setText(selector, value) {
  const element = $(selector);
  if (element) {
    element.textContent = value;
  }
}

function setServerStatus(online) {
  const indicator = $("#server-indicator");
  if (indicator) {
    indicator.classList.remove("online", "offline", "checking");
    indicator.classList.add(online ? "online" : "offline");
  }
  setText("#server-status", online ? "Servidor online" : "Servidor offline");
}

async function fetchJson(endpoint, options = {}) {
  const response = await fetch(endpoint, {
    method: options.method || "GET",
    headers: {
      ...(options.body ? { "Content-Type": "application/json" } : {}),
      ...(options.headers || {})
    },
    body: options.body ? JSON.stringify(options.body) : undefined,
    cache: "no-store"
  });

  const data = await response.json().catch(() => ({}));
  if (!response.ok) {
    throw new Error(data.error || `Erro HTTP ${response.status}`);
  }
  return data;
}

function createCopyMarkdownButton(markdownText, defaultLabel, className = "btn-secondary") {
  const btn = document.createElement("button");
  btn.type = "button";
  btn.className = className;
  btn.innerHTML = `${SVG_ICONS.clipboard}<span>${escapeHtml(defaultLabel)}</span>`;

  btn.addEventListener("click", async (e) => {
    e.stopPropagation();
    try {
      await navigator.clipboard.writeText(markdownText);
      btn.innerHTML = `${SVG_ICONS.check}<span>Markdown Copiado</span>`;
      setTimeout(() => {
        btn.innerHTML = `${SVG_ICONS.clipboard}<span>${escapeHtml(defaultLabel)}</span>`;
      }, 2000);
    } catch {
      btn.textContent = "Selecione manualmente abaixo";
    }
  });

  return btn;
}

// ============================================================================
// NAVEGAÇÃO ENTRE ABAS (CHAT / DASHBOARD / HISTÓRICO) E DRAWERS
// ============================================================================

function switchView(targetView) {
  currentView = targetView;

  for (const navBtn of $$("[data-view-target]")) {
    const isMatch = navBtn.getAttribute("data-view-target") === targetView;
    navBtn.classList.toggle("active", isMatch);
  }

  for (const section of $$(".stage-view")) {
    const isMatch = section.getAttribute("data-view") === targetView;
    section.classList.toggle("active", isMatch);
    section.hidden = !isMatch;
  }

  updateStageTopbar();
  closeMobileDrawers();
}

function selectDebate(debateId) {
  selectedDebateId = debateId;
  lastRenderedChatSignature = "";
  if (currentView !== "chat") {
    switchView("chat");
  } else {
    renderSidebarDebatesList();
    renderChatStage();
    updateStageTopbar();
    updateRightAiPanel();
  }
  closeMobileDrawers();
}

function startNewDebateView() {
  selectedDebateId = null;
  optimisticSubmission = null;
  lastRenderedChatSignature = "";
  switchView("chat");
  renderSidebarDebatesList();
  renderChatStage();
  updateStageTopbar();
  updateRightAiPanel();

  const topicInput = $("#debate-topic");
  if (topicInput) {
    topicInput.focus();
  }
}

function closeMobileDrawers() {
  $("#left-sidebar")?.classList.remove("is-open");
  $("#right-ai-panel")?.classList.remove("is-open");
  $("#mobile-backdrop")?.classList.remove("is-visible");
}

// ATUALIZAÇÃO DA TOPBAR CENTRAL
// ============================================================================

function getActiveOrSelectedDebate() {
  if (selectedDebateId) {
    const found = latestDebates.find((d) => d.id === selectedDebateId);
    if (found) return found;
  }
  return null;
}

function getReferenceDebateForRightPanel() {
  // Prioriza o debate aberto no chat; se nenhum estiver aberto, mostra o que estiver running
  const selected = getActiveOrSelectedDebate();
  if (selected) return selected;
  return latestDebates.find((d) => d.status === "running") || null;
}

function updateStageTopbar() {
  const breadcrumb = $("#topbar-breadcrumb");
  const titleEl = $("#topbar-title");
  const metaEl = $("#topbar-meta");
  const actionsWrap = $("#topbar-debate-actions");

  if (!breadcrumb || !titleEl || !metaEl || !actionsWrap) return;

  actionsWrap.replaceChildren();

  if (currentView === "dashboard") {
    breadcrumb.textContent = "VISÃO GERAL & MONITORAMENTO";
    titleEl.textContent = "Resumo do Sistema e Inteligências";
    metaEl.textContent =
      "Acompanhe a disponibilidade, o consumo diário de cotas gratuitas e as sessões armazenadas.";

    const badge = document.createElement("span");
    badge.className = "tag-badge tag-neutral";
    badge.textContent = "Monitor Local Ativo";
    const zeroCost = document.createElement("span");
    zeroCost.className = "tag-badge tag-outline";
    zeroCost.textContent = "Custo Zero";
    actionsWrap.append(badge, zeroCost);
    return;
  }

  if (currentView === "history") {
    breadcrumb.textContent = "ATIVIDADE & HISTÓRICO";
    titleEl.textContent = "Registros do Monitor Local";
    metaEl.textContent =
      "Histórico cronológico de eventos e alertas de limite capturados nas plataformas.";

    const badge = document.createElement("span");
    badge.className = "tag-badge tag-neutral";
    badge.textContent = `${latestEvents.length} evento(s)`;
    actionsWrap.appendChild(badge);
    return;
  }

  // View === "chat"
  if (optimisticSubmission) {
    breadcrumb.textContent = "CHAT DE DEBATES • INICIANDO";
    titleEl.textContent = optimisticSubmission.title;
    const partNames = optimisticSubmission.participants
      .map((p) => PLATFORMS[p] || p)
      .join(", ");
    metaEl.textContent = `Rodada 1/${optimisticSubmission.totalRounds} • Etapa: Análise Inicial • Participantes: ${partNames}`;

    const runningBadge = document.createElement("span");
    runningBadge.className = "debate-status-badge running";
    runningBadge.textContent = "Pensando...";
    const zeroBadge = document.createElement("span");
    zeroBadge.className = "tag-badge tag-outline";
    zeroBadge.textContent = "Custo Zero";
    actionsWrap.append(runningBadge, zeroBadge);
    return;
  }

  const debate = getActiveOrSelectedDebate();

  if (!debate) {
    breadcrumb.textContent = "CHAT DE DEBATES";
    titleEl.textContent = "Novo Debate em Consenso";
    metaEl.textContent =
      "Selecione as inteligências participantes no Composer abaixo e envie um problema para análise.";

    const readyBadge = document.createElement("span");
    readyBadge.className = "tag-badge tag-neutral";
    readyBadge.textContent = "Pronto para iniciar";
    const zeroBadge = document.createElement("span");
    zeroBadge.className = "tag-badge tag-outline";
    zeroBadge.textContent = "Custo Zero";
    actionsWrap.append(readyBadge, zeroBadge);
    return;
  }

  const stageText = STAGE_LABELS[debate.currentStage] || debate.currentStage;
  const participantsList = (debate.participants || [])
    .map((p) => PLATFORMS[p] || p)
    .join(", ");

  breadcrumb.textContent = `CHAT DE DEBATES • ${(FOCUS_LABELS[debate.focus] || "Geral").toUpperCase()}`;
  titleEl.textContent = debate.title;
  metaEl.textContent = `Rodada ${debate.currentRound}/${debate.totalRounds} • Etapa: ${stageText} • Participantes: ${participantsList}`;

  const statusBadge = document.createElement("span");
  statusBadge.className = `debate-status-badge ${debate.status}`;
  statusBadge.textContent = STATUS_LABELS[debate.status] || debate.status;
  actionsWrap.appendChild(statusBadge);

  const zeroBadge = document.createElement("span");
  zeroBadge.className = "tag-badge tag-outline";
  zeroBadge.textContent = "Custo Zero";
  actionsWrap.appendChild(zeroBadge);

  if (debate.status === "running") {
    const pauseBtn = document.createElement("button");
    pauseBtn.type = "button";
    pauseBtn.className = "btn-secondary";
    pauseBtn.innerHTML = `${SVG_ICONS.pause}<span>Pausar Debate</span>`;
    pauseBtn.addEventListener("click", () => handlePauseDebate(debate.id));
    actionsWrap.appendChild(pauseBtn);
  } else if (
    debate.status === "paused_limit" ||
    debate.status === "paused_error" ||
    debate.status === "paused_manual"
  ) {
    const resumeBtn = document.createElement("button");
    resumeBtn.type = "button";
    resumeBtn.className = "btn-primary";
    resumeBtn.innerHTML = `${SVG_ICONS.play}<span>Retomar do Ponto Exato</span>`;
    resumeBtn.addEventListener("click", () => handleResumeDebate(debate.id));
    actionsWrap.appendChild(resumeBtn);
  }
}

// ============================================================================
// SIDEBAR ESQUERDA: LISTA DE CONVERSAS / DEBATES (ESTILO CHATGPT)
// ============================================================================

function renderSidebarDebatesList() {
  const listEl = $("#sidebar-debate-list");
  const countEl = $("#sidebar-debates-count");
  if (!listEl) return;

  if (countEl) {
    countEl.textContent = String(latestDebates.length);
  }

  listEl.replaceChildren();

  if (latestDebates.length === 0) {
    const empty = document.createElement("div");
    empty.className = "sidebar-empty";
    empty.textContent = "Nenhum debate registrado";
    listEl.appendChild(empty);
    return;
  }

  for (const [idx, debate] of latestDebates.entries()) {
    const btn = document.createElement("button");
    btn.type = "button";
    btn.className = "conversation-item";
    btn.style.animationDelay = `${Math.min(idx * 0.04, 0.32)}s`;
    if (debate.id === selectedDebateId && currentView === "chat") {
      btn.classList.add("active");
    }

    const topRow = document.createElement("div");
    topRow.className = "conversation-item-top";

    const titleSpan = document.createElement("span");
    titleSpan.className = "conversation-title";
    titleSpan.textContent = debate.title;

    const statePill = document.createElement("span");
    const isRunning = debate.status === "running";
    statePill.className = `conv-state-pill${isRunning ? " running" : ""}`;
    statePill.textContent = isRunning
      ? "Ativo"
      : debate.status === "completed"
        ? "OK"
        : "Pausa";

    topRow.append(titleSpan, statePill);

    const metaRow = document.createElement("div");
    metaRow.className = "conversation-meta";

    const statusText = document.createElement("span");
    statusText.textContent =
      debate.status === "running"
        ? `Pensando • R${debate.currentRound}/${debate.totalRounds}`
        : debate.status === "completed"
          ? `Concluído • ${debate.totalRounds} rodadas`
          : `Pausado • R${debate.currentRound}/${debate.totalRounds}`;

    const dateText = document.createElement("span");
    dateText.textContent = formatShortTime(debate.updatedAt || debate.createdAt);

    metaRow.append(statusText, dateText);
    btn.append(topRow, metaRow);

    btn.addEventListener("click", () => {
      selectDebate(debate.id);
    });

    listEl.appendChild(btn);
  }
}
