import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";

import {
  ALL_PLATFORMS,
  isAutoPlatform,
  type AIPlatform,
  type CreateDebateInput,
  type DebateFocus,
  type DebateResponse,
  type DebateSession,
  type DebateStage,
  type DebateTask,
  type ParticipantState,
  type SubmitResponseInput,
  type SubmitResponseMeta
} from "../shared/debate-types.js";

import {
  readDebateSessions,
  withDebateLock,
  writeDebateSessionsAtomically
} from "../persistence/debate-store.js";

// ============================================
// CONSTANTES
// ============================================

export const ENGINE_VERSION = 2;

export const PLATFORM_NAMES: Record<AIPlatform, string> = {
  chatgpt: "ChatGPT",
  claude: "Claude",
  gemini: "Gemini",
  groq: "Groq",
  openrouter: "OpenRouter"
};

const DEFAULT_RULES =
  "Seja curto, direto e 100% concreto. Sem enrolação, sem introdução longa e sem teoria desnecessária. Foque na solução prática e acionável.";

const MAX_TOKENS = {
  initial_response: 1100,
  critique: 1100,
  synthesis: 1600
} as const;

// Limites de contexto reenviado entre rodadas (economia de tokens).
const COMPACT_CRITIQUE_CHARS = 3000;
const COMPACT_SYNTHESIS_CHARS = 4500;

export const DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT = [
  "Você integra o AI Council, um conselho técnico de IAs que debate para chegar à melhor resposta.",
  "Responda sempre em Markdown, em português do Brasil, de forma curta, direta e concreta.",
  "Sem introdução, sem elogios e sem repetir o enunciado.",
  "Use código somente quando necessário, em blocos com a linguagem indicada.",
  "Se faltar informação, assuma o mais razoável e escreva a suposição em uma linha."
].join(" ");

const FRONTEND_RULES = [
  "Evite o visual genérico de IA: sem gradientes roxo/azul, sem emojis em títulos,",
  "sem grade de cards idênticos com sombra, sem excesso de ícones decorativos,",
  "sem textos de marketing vagos. Defina tipografia, escala de espaçamento,",
  "paleta com uma única cor de destaque e hierarquia visual coerentes.",
  "Prefira detalhes específicos do produto e alinhamentos intencionais."
].join(" ");

// ============================================
// PAPÉIS (cada IA recebe uma função diferente)
// ============================================

interface Role {
  title: string;
  round1: string;
  critique: string;
}

function roleFor(platform: AIPlatform, focus: DebateFocus): Role {
  switch (platform) {
    case "gemini":
      return {
        title: "Arquiteto e relator",
        round1:
          "Proponha a solução principal: estrutura/arquitetura e o código essencial.",
        critique:
          "Mantenha o que for bom, corrija as falhas apontadas e consolide a solução."
      };

    case "groq":
      return {
        title: "Revisor técnico (bugs, segurança e casos de borda)",
        round1:
          "Proponha sua solução priorizando bugs prováveis, segurança, tratamento de erros e casos de borda.",
        critique:
          "Ataque as propostas: aponte falhas concretas (bugs, segurança, casos de borda) e entregue a versão corrigida."
      };

    case "openrouter":
      if (focus === "frontend") {
        return {
          title: "Revisor de UX e estética (sem cara de IA)",
          round1: `Proponha a interface com foco em UX e estética. ${FRONTEND_RULES}`,
          critique: `Critique a interface proposta e entregue a versão melhorada. ${FRONTEND_RULES}`
        };
      }

      if (focus === "backend") {
        return {
          title: "Revisor de simplicidade e manutenção",
          round1:
            "Proponha a solução mais simples que resolve o problema, com baixo acoplamento e fácil manutenção.",
          critique:
            "Corte complexidade desnecessária, aponte acoplamentos e dívida técnica e entregue a versão mais simples."
        };
      }

      return {
        title: "Voz alternativa",
        round1: "Proponha uma abordagem diferente da mais óbvia, explicando o trade-off.",
        critique:
          "Questione as premissas das propostas e entregue a alternativa mais sólida."
      };

    case "chatgpt":
      return {
        title: "Autor alternativo",
        round1: "Proponha uma abordagem diferente da mais óbvia, explicando o trade-off.",
        critique: "Aponte o que as demais propostas ignoraram e entregue sua versão melhorada."
      };

    case "claude":
      return {
        title: "Revisor de qualidade e legibilidade",
        round1: "Proponha a solução priorizando clareza, nomes bons e fácil manutenção.",
        critique:
          "Revise clareza, legibilidade e manutenção das propostas e entregue a versão consolidada."
      };
  }
}

// ============================================
// UTILITÁRIOS DE PROMPT
// ============================================

/** Reduz uma resposta longa mantendo início e fim (evita reenviar tudo a cada rodada). */
export function compactForPrompt(text: string, maxChars: number): string {
  const clean = text.trim();

  if (clean.length <= maxChars) {
    return clean;
  }

  const head = clean.slice(0, Math.floor(maxChars * 0.7));
  const tail = clean.slice(-Math.floor(maxChars * 0.25));

  let output = `${head}\n\n[... trecho omitido para economizar tokens ...]\n\n${tail}`;

  const fenceCount = (output.match(/^```/gm) ?? []).length;
  if (fenceCount % 2 === 1) {
    output += "\n```";
  }

  return output;
}

function combinePrompt(system: string, user: string): string {
  return `${system}\n\n---\n\n${user}`;
}

function labelFor(platform: AIPlatform, focus: DebateFocus): string {
  return `${PLATFORM_NAMES[platform]} — ${roleFor(platform, focus).title}`;
}

function focusOf(session: DebateSession): DebateFocus {
  return session.focus ?? "geral";
}

function buildInitialUserPrompt(
  session: DebateSession,
  platform: AIPlatform
): string {
  const role = roleFor(platform, focusOf(session));

  return [
    `Tema: ${session.title}`,
    ``,
    `Problema:`,
    session.topic,
    ``,
    `Diretriz: ${session.rules}`,
    ``,
    `Seu papel: ${role.title}.`,
    role.round1,
    `Seja enxuto: no máximo ~350 palavras fora blocos de código.`
  ].join("\n");
}

function buildPreviousBlock(
  session: DebateSession,
  round: number,
  maxChars: number
): string {
  const focus = focusOf(session);

  return session.responses
    .filter((resp) => resp.round === round)
    .map((resp) =>
      [
        `### ${labelFor(resp.platform, focus)}`,
        compactForPrompt(resp.content, maxChars)
      ].join("\n")
    )
    .join("\n\n");
}

function buildCritiqueUserPrompt(
  session: DebateSession,
  round: number,
  platform: AIPlatform
): string {
  const role = roleFor(platform, focusOf(session));
  const previousRound = round - 1;

  return [
    `Problema: ${session.topic}`,
    `Diretriz: ${session.rules}`,
    ``,
    `Propostas da rodada ${previousRound} (resumidas):`,
    ``,
    buildPreviousBlock(session, previousRound, COMPACT_CRITIQUE_CHARS),
    ``,
    `Seu papel: ${role.title}.`,
    role.critique,
    `Formato: (1) no máximo 3 falhas objetivas; (2) a versão melhorada e consolidada. Seja curto.`
  ].join("\n");
}

function buildSynthesisUserPrompt(session: DebateSession): string {
  return [
    `Pedido original: ${session.topic}`,
    `Diretriz: ${session.rules}`,
    ``,
    `Posições finais da rodada ${session.totalRounds}:`,
    ``,
    buildPreviousBlock(session, session.totalRounds, COMPACT_SYNTHESIS_CHARS),
    ``,
    `Você é o relator. Entregue em Markdown, de forma curta e pronta para uso:`,
    `1. "# Solução final" — a solução consolidada (com o código necessário).`,
    `2. "## Conclusão do conselho" — um parágrafo curto com o consenso e as divergências que restaram.`
  ].join("\n");
}

// ============================================
// CRIAÇÃO DE TAREFAS
// ============================================

function createInitialParticipantStates(
  participants: AIPlatform[]
): Record<AIPlatform, ParticipantState> {
  const states = {} as Record<AIPlatform, ParticipantState>;

  for (const platform of ALL_PLATFORMS) {
    if (participants.includes(platform)) {
      states[platform] = {
        platform,
        availability: "unknown"
      };
    }
  }

  return states;
}

function pickRelator(session: DebateSession): AIPlatform {
  if (session.participants.includes("gemini")) return "gemini";

  const firstAuto = session.participants.find((p) => isAutoPlatform(p));
  return firstAuto ?? session.participants[0] ?? "gemini";
}

function buildTask(
  session: DebateSession,
  round: number,
  stage: Exclude<DebateStage, "completed">,
  platform: AIPlatform
): DebateTask {
  const focus = focusOf(session);
  const role = roleFor(platform, focus);

  const userPrompt =
    stage === "initial_response"
      ? buildInitialUserPrompt(session, platform)
      : stage === "critique"
        ? buildCritiqueUserPrompt(session, round, platform)
        : buildSynthesisUserPrompt(session);

  return {
    id: randomUUID(),
    round,
    stage,
    platform,
    status: "pending",
    createdAt: new Date().toISOString(),
    seat: isAutoPlatform(platform) ? "auto" : "manual",
    role: stage === "synthesis" ? "Relator" : role.title,
    systemPrompt: DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
    userPrompt,
    maxTokens: MAX_TOKENS[stage],
    prompt: combinePrompt(DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT, userPrompt)
  };
}

function createTasksForStage(
  session: DebateSession,
  round: number,
  stage: Exclude<DebateStage, "completed">
): DebateTask[] {
  if (stage === "synthesis") {
    return [buildTask(session, round, "synthesis", pickRelator(session))];
  }

  return session.participants.map((platform) =>
    buildTask(session, round, stage, platform)
  );
}

// ============================================
// CONSULTAS
// ============================================

export async function listDebateSessions(): Promise<DebateSession[]> {
  const sessions = await readDebateSessions();
  return [...sessions].sort(
    (a, b) => Date.parse(b.createdAt) - Date.parse(a.createdAt)
  );
}

export async function getDebateSessionById(
  debateId: string
): Promise<DebateSession | null> {
  const sessions = await readDebateSessions();
  return sessions.find((s) => s.id === debateId) ?? null;
}

export async function deleteDebateSession(
  debateId: string
): Promise<boolean> {
  return withDebateLock(async () => {
    const sessions = await readDebateSessions();
    const filtered = sessions.filter((s) => s.id !== debateId);

    if (filtered.length === sessions.length) {
      return false;
    }

    await writeDebateSessionsAtomically(filtered);
    return true;
  });
}

// ============================================
// CRIAÇÃO DE DEBATE
// ============================================

export async function createDebateSession(
  input: CreateDebateInput
): Promise<DebateSession> {
  const uniqueParticipants = Array.from(new Set(input.participants));

  if (uniqueParticipants.length < 2) {
    throw new Error(
      "O debate precisa ter pelo menos 2 inteligências participantes."
    );
  }

  const totalRounds = Math.min(Math.max(Number(input.totalRounds) || 2, 1), 3);
  const now = new Date().toISOString();
  const title = input.title.trim();
  const topic = input.topic.trim();
  const rules = (input.rules || DEFAULT_RULES).trim();

  const focus: DebateFocus =
    input.focus === "backend" || input.focus === "frontend"
      ? input.focus
      : "geral";

  if (!title || !topic) {
    throw new Error("Título e tema do debate são obrigatórios.");
  }

  return withDebateLock(async () => {
    const sessions = await readDebateSessions();

    // Pausa debates antigos abertos para que o novo seja o único ativo (running).
    for (const old of sessions) {
      if (old.status === "running") {
        old.status = "paused_manual";
        old.pauseInfo = {
          reason: "manual_pause",
          message: "Pausado automaticamente ao iniciar um novo debate.",
          pausedAt: now
        };
      }
    }

    const newSession: DebateSession = {
      id: randomUUID(),
      title,
      topic,
      rules,
      participants: uniqueParticipants,
      totalRounds,
      currentRound: 1,
      currentStage: "initial_response",
      status: "running",
      participantStates: createInitialParticipantStates(uniqueParticipants),
      tasks: [],
      responses: [],
      createdAt: now,
      updatedAt: now,
      focus,
      engineVersion: ENGINE_VERSION
    };

    newSession.tasks = createTasksForStage(newSession, 1, "initial_response");

    sessions.push(newSession);
    await writeDebateSessionsAtomically(sessions);

    return newSession;
  });
}

// ============================================
// REGISTRO DE RESPOSTAS
// ============================================

function stripLegacyWrappers(raw: string): string {
  return raw
    .replace(/^~~~~+markdown\s*/i, "")
    .replace(/^~~~+markdown\s*/i, "")
    .replace(/^```+markdown\s*/i, "")
    .replace(/~~~~+\s*$/i, "")
    .replace(/\[FIM_DA_RESPOSTA\]/gi, "")
    .trim();
}

export async function submitDebateTaskResponse(
  debateId: string,
  input: SubmitResponseInput,
  meta: SubmitResponseMeta = {}
): Promise<DebateSession> {
  const content = stripLegacyWrappers(input.content);

  if (!content) {
    throw new Error("O conteúdo da resposta não pode estar vazio.");
  }

  return withDebateLock(async () => {
    const sessions = await readDebateSessions();
    const session = sessions.find((s) => s.id === debateId);

    if (!session) {
      throw new Error("Sessão de debate não encontrada.");
    }

    if (session.status === "completed") {
      throw new Error("O debate já foi concluído.");
    }

    if (session.status !== "running" && !meta.allowWhilePaused) {
      throw new Error(
        "Não é possível registrar respostas enquanto o debate estiver pausado ou concluído."
      );
    }

    const task = session.tasks.find((t) => t.id === input.taskId);

    if (!task) {
      throw new Error("Tarefa não encontrada neste debate.");
    }

    if (task.status === "completed") {
      return session;
    }

    const echoProbe = task.userPrompt?.trim().slice(0, 120);

    if (
      content === task.prompt.trim() ||
      (echoProbe && echoProbe.length > 40 && content.includes(echoProbe))
    ) {
      throw new Error(
        "O texto colado é o próprio prompt da pergunta. Cole a resposta real da IA."
      );
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    task.status = "completed";
    task.completedAt = now;
    delete task.lastError;

    const responseRecord: DebateResponse = {
      id: randomUUID(),
      taskId: task.id,
      round: task.round,
      stage: task.stage,
      platform: task.platform,
      promptUsed: task.prompt,
      content,
      submittedAt: now,
      ...(meta.model ? { model: meta.model } : {}),
      ...(meta.tokens !== undefined ? { tokens: meta.tokens } : {})
    };

    session.responses.push(responseRecord);
    session.updatedAt = now;

    const pendingInCurrentStage = session.tasks.some(
      (t) =>
        t.round === session.currentRound &&
        t.stage === session.currentStage &&
        t.status === "pending"
    );

    if (!pendingInCurrentStage) {
      if (session.currentStage === "synthesis") {
        session.currentStage = "completed";
        session.status = "completed";
        session.conclusion = content;
        session.completedAt = now;
        delete session.pauseInfo;
      } else if (session.currentRound < session.totalRounds) {
        session.currentRound += 1;
        session.currentStage = "critique";
        session.tasks.push(
          ...createTasksForStage(session, session.currentRound, "critique")
        );
      } else {
        session.currentStage = "synthesis";
        session.tasks.push(
          ...createTasksForStage(session, session.currentRound, "synthesis")
        );
      }
    }

    await writeDebateSessionsAtomically(sessions);
    return session;
  });
}

// ============================================
// FALHAS DE PROVEDOR
// ============================================

export async function recordTaskFailure(
  debateId: string,
  taskId: string,
  message: string,
  options: { maxAttempts?: number; fatal?: boolean } = {}
): Promise<DebateSession | null> {
  return withDebateLock(async () => {
    const sessions = await readDebateSessions();
    const session = sessions.find((s) => s.id === debateId);
    const task = session?.tasks.find((t) => t.id === taskId);

    if (!session || !task || task.status === "completed") {
      return null;
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    task.attempts = (task.attempts ?? 0) + 1;
    task.lastError = message.slice(0, 400);
    session.updatedAt = now;

    const exhausted =
      options.fatal === true || task.attempts >= (options.maxAttempts ?? 2);

    if (exhausted && session.status === "running") {
      session.status = "paused_error";
      session.pauseInfo = {
        reason: "provider_error",
        blockedBy: task.platform,
        message: `Debate pausado: ${PLATFORM_NAMES[task.platform]} falhou (${task.lastError}). Corrija o problema e clique em Retomar. O progresso foi preservado.`,
        pausedAt: now
      };
    }

    await writeDebateSessionsAtomically(sessions);
    return session;
  });
}

// ============================================
// PAUSA E RETOMADA
// ============================================

export async function pauseDebateManually(
  debateId: string,
  reasonMessage?: string
): Promise<DebateSession> {
  return withDebateLock(async () => {
    const sessions = await readDebateSessions();
    const session = sessions.find((s) => s.id === debateId);

    if (!session) {
      throw new Error("Sessão de debate não encontrada.");
    }

    if (session.status === "completed") {
      throw new Error("O debate já foi concluído.");
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    session.status = "paused_manual";
    session.pauseInfo = {
      reason: "manual_pause",
      message:
        reasonMessage?.trim() ||
        "Debate pausado manualmente pelo usuário. Todo o progresso foi salvo.",
      pausedAt: now
    };
    session.updatedAt = now;

    await writeDebateSessionsAtomically(sessions);
    return session;
  });
}

export async function resumeDebateSession(
  debateId: string
): Promise<DebateSession> {
  return withDebateLock(async () => {
    const sessions = await readDebateSessions();
    const session = sessions.find((s) => s.id === debateId);

    if (!session) {
      throw new Error("Sessão de debate não encontrada.");
    }

    if (session.status === "completed") {
      throw new Error("O debate já está concluído.");
    }

    const now = new Date().toISOString();

    if (session.pauseInfo?.blockedBy) {
      const blockedPlatform = session.pauseInfo.blockedBy;
      if (session.participantStates[blockedPlatform]) {
        session.participantStates[blockedPlatform] = {
          ...session.participantStates[blockedPlatform],
          availability: "unknown"
        };
      }
    }

    // Recomeça a contagem de tentativas das tarefas pendentes.
    for (const task of session.tasks) {
      if (task.status === "pending") {
        delete task.attempts;
        delete task.lastError;
      }
    }

    session.status = "running";
    delete session.pauseInfo;
    session.updatedAt = now;

    await writeDebateSessionsAtomically(sessions);
    return session;
  });
}

export async function applyLimitSignalToDebates(
  platform: AIPlatform,
  severity: "warning" | "blocked",
  matchedText: string,
  observedAt: string
): Promise<{ pausedDebateIds: string[] }> {
  return withDebateLock(async () => {
    const sessions = await readDebateSessions();
    const pausedDebateIds: string[] = [];
    let modified = false;

    for (const session of sessions) {
      if (!session.participants.includes(platform)) {
        continue;
      }

      if (session.status === "completed") {
        continue;
      }

      session.participantStates[platform] = {
        platform,
        availability: severity,
        lastSignalAt: observedAt,
        lastLimitMessage: matchedText
      };
      session.updatedAt = observedAt;
      modified = true;

      if (severity === "blocked" && session.status === "running") {
        session.status = "paused_limit";
        session.pauseInfo = {
          reason: "usage_limit_reached",
          blockedBy: platform,
          message: `Debate pausado automaticamente: ${PLATFORM_NAMES[platform]} atingiu o limite gratuito ("${matchedText}"). Estado preservado.`,
          pausedAt: observedAt
        };
        pausedDebateIds.push(session.id);
      }
    }

    if (modified) {
      await writeDebateSessionsAtomically(sessions);
    }

    return { pausedDebateIds };
  });
}

========================================
ARQUIVO: ./src/debate/runner.ts
========================================
import {
  applyLimitSignalToDebates,
  DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
  listDebateSessions,
  PLATFORM_NAMES,
  recordTaskFailure,
  submitDebateTaskResponse
} from "./debate-engine.js";

import {
  getProvider,
  getProviderIssue,
  initProviders
} from "../providers/registry.js";

import { classifyError } from "../providers/types.js";
import { isAutoPlatform, type DebateTask } from "../shared/debate-types.js";

const TICK_MS = 2_500;
// Cada tarefa já faz até 2-3 tentativas HTTP dentro do provedor (e cada uma conta
// no limite diário). Por isso uma falha pausa o debate de imediato.
const MAX_TASK_ATTEMPTS = 1;
const RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS = 8_000;
const MAX_CHAINED_PASSES = 12;

const inFlight = new Set<string>();
const retryNotBefore = new Map<string, number>();

let timer: NodeJS.Timeout | undefined;
let ticking = false;
let rerunRequested = false;

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Execução de uma tarefa automática
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

async function runTask(debateId: string, task: DebateTask): Promise<boolean> {
  inFlight.add(task.id);

  try {
    if (!isAutoPlatform(task.platform)) {
      return false;
    }

    const platform = task.platform;
    const label = PLATFORM_NAMES[platform];
    const provider = getProvider(platform);

    if (!provider) {
      const reason = getProviderIssue(platform) ?? "provedor não configurado.";
      await recordTaskFailure(
        debateId,
        task.id,
        `${label} indisponível: ${reason}`,
        { fatal: true }
      );
      return false;
    }

    let result;

    try {
      result = await provider.generate({
        system: task.systemPrompt ?? DEFAULT_SYSTEM_PROMPT,
        user: task.userPrompt ?? task.prompt,
        maxTokens: task.maxTokens ?? 1100
      });
    } catch (error) {
      const failure = classifyError(error);

      if (failure.kind === "rate_limit" || failure.kind === "quota_exhausted") {
        const { pausedDebateIds } = await applyLimitSignalToDebates(
          platform,
          "blocked",
          failure.message.slice(0, 200),
          new Date().toISOString()
        );

        console.warn(
          `[AI Council] ${label}: limite atingido. Debates pausados:`,
          pausedDebateIds.join(", ") || "nenhum"
        );

        return false;
      }

      const fatal = failure.kind === "auth" || failure.kind === "model";

      const updated = await recordTaskFailure(debateId, task.id, failure.message, {
        maxAttempts: MAX_TASK_ATTEMPTS,
        fatal
      });

      const attempts =
        updated?.tasks.find((t) => t.id === task.id)?.attempts ?? 1;

      retryNotBefore.set(task.id, Date.now() + RETRY_BASE_DELAY_MS * attempts);

      console.warn(
        `[AI Council] ${label} falhou (${failure.kind}): ${failure.message.slice(0, 160)}`
      );

      return false;
    }

    try {
      await submitDebateTaskResponse(
        debateId,
        { taskId: task.id, content: result.text },
        {
          allowWhilePaused: true,
          model: result.model,
          tokens: result.totalTokens
        }
      );
    } catch (error) {
      console.error(
        "[AI Council] Resposta recebida mas não registrada:",
        error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
      );
      return false;
    }

    console.log(
      `[AI Council] ${label} respondeu (${result.model}, ${result.totalTokens ?? "?"} tokens) — rodada ${task.round}/${task.stage}`
    );

    return true;
  } finally {
    inFlight.delete(task.id);
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Varredura
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

async function processOnce(): Promise<boolean> {
  const sessions = await listDebateSessions();
  const now = Date.now();
  let didWork = false;

  // Só automatiza debates criados pela engine v2 (os antigos continuam manuais).
  const active = sessions.filter(
    (s) => s.status === "running" && (s.engineVersion ?? 0) >= 2
  );

  for (const session of active) {
    const pending = session.tasks.filter(
      (task) =>
        task.status === "pending" &&
        task.round === session.currentRound &&
        task.stage === session.currentStage &&
        isAutoPlatform(task.platform) &&
        !inFlight.has(task.id) &&
        (retryNotBefore.get(task.id) ?? 0) <= now
    );

    if (pending.length === 0) continue;

    // Provedores diferentes em paralelo; cada um respeita o próprio UsageGate.
    const outcomes = await Promise.all(
      pending.map((task) => runTask(session.id, task))
    );

    if (outcomes.some(Boolean)) {
      didWork = true;
    }
  }

  return didWork;
}

async function tick(): Promise<void> {
  if (ticking) {
    rerunRequested = true;
    return;
  }

  ticking = true;

  try {
    let passes = 0;

    do {
      rerunRequested = false;
      const didWork = await processOnce();
      passes += 1;

      // Se algo foi concluído, a etapa pode ter avançado: varre de novo já.
      if (didWork) rerunRequested = true;
    } while (rerunRequested && passes < MAX_CHAINED_PASSES);
  } catch (error) {
    console.error(
      "[AI Council] Erro no runner:",
      error instanceof Error ? error.message : error
    );
  } finally {
    ticking = false;
  }
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// API pública
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

export function startRunner(): void {
  if (timer) return;

  initProviders();

  timer = setInterval(() => {
    void tick();
  }, TICK_MS);

  void tick();
  console.log("[AI Council] Runner automático ativo (Gemini, Groq e OpenRouter).");
}

export function stopRunner(): void {
  if (timer) {
    clearInterval(timer);
    timer = undefined;
  }
}

/** Pede uma varredura imediata (ex.: depois de criar ou retomar um debate). */
export function kickRunner(): void {
  void tick();
}

ARQUIVO: ./src/monitor.ts

import "dotenv/config";

import {
  createServer,
  type IncomingMessage,
  type ServerResponse
} from "node:http";

import {
  mkdir,
  readFile,
  writeFile,
  rename,
  rm
} from "node:fs/promises";

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { dirname, resolve, extname, sep } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

import { ALL_PLATFORMS, type AIPlatform } from "./shared/debate-types.js";
import {
  applyLimitSignalToDebates,
  createDebateSession,
  listDebateSessions,
  pauseDebateManually,
  resumeDebateSession,
  submitDebateTaskResponse
} from "./debate/debate-engine.js";
import { kickRunner, startRunner } from "./debate/runner.js";
import { getProvidersStatus } from "./providers/registry.js";

// ============================================
// CONFIGURAÇÃO
// ============================================

const ROOT_DIR = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "..");
const DATA_DIR = resolve(ROOT_DIR, "data");
const EVENTS_FILE = resolve(DATA_DIR, "monitor-events.json");
const PUBLIC_DIR = resolve(ROOT_DIR, "public");

const HOST = "127.0.0.1";
const PORT = 4317;

const DASHBOARD_ORIGIN = `http://${HOST}:${PORT}`;

const TOKEN = process.env.MONITOR_TOKEN;

const MAX_BODY_SIZE = 65_536;
const MAX_HISTORY = 200;
const SERVER_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS = 30_000;

const MOZ_EXTENSION_ORIGIN_REGEX =
  /^moz-extension:\/\/[0-9a-f]{8}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{4}-[0-9a-f]{12}$/i;

// Fontes de eventos de limite enviados pela extensão (opcional, legado).
const VALID_SOURCES = new Set<string>([
  "chatgpt",
  "claude",
  "gemini"
]);

// Participantes aceitos nos debates (automáticos e manuais).
const VALID_PARTICIPANTS = new Set<string>(ALL_PLATFORMS);

const VALID_SEVERITIES = new Set<string>([
  "warning",
  "blocked"
]);

const VALID_SIGNALS = new Set<string>([
  "usage_limit_reached",
  "approaching_usage_limit"
]);

const VALID_CONFIDENCE = new Set<string>([
  "high",
  "medium"
]);

const VALID_URLS = new Set<string>([
  "https://chatgpt.com",
  "https://claude.ai",
  "https://gemini.google.com"
]);

const EXPECTED_SIGNAL_BY_SEVERITY: Record<
  IncomingMonitorEvent["severity"],
  IncomingMonitorEvent["signal"]
> = {
  warning: "approaching_usage_limit",
  blocked: "usage_limit_reached"
};

const EXPECTED_URL_BY_SOURCE: Record<
  IncomingMonitorEvent["source"],
  string
> = {
  chatgpt: "https://chatgpt.com",
  claude: "https://claude.ai",
  gemini: "https://gemini.google.com"
};

const MIME_TYPES: Record<string, string> = {
  ".html": "text/html; charset=utf-8",
  ".css": "text/css; charset=utf-8",
  ".js": "text/javascript; charset=utf-8"
};

// ============================================
// TIPOS
// ============================================

interface IncomingMonitorEvent {
  source: "chatgpt" | "claude" | "gemini";
  severity: "warning" | "blocked";
  signal:
    | "usage_limit_reached"
    | "approaching_usage_limit";
  confidence: "high" | "medium";
  message: string;
  matchedText: string;
  url: string;
}

interface StoredMonitorEvent {
  source: "chatgpt" | "claude" | "gemini";
  severity: "warning" | "blocked";

  signal?:
    | "usage_limit_reached"
    | "approaching_usage_limit";

  confidence?: "high" | "medium";

  message: string;
  matchedText: string;
  url: string;
  observedAt: string;
}

// ============================================
// VALIDAÇÃO
// ============================================

function isRecord(
  value: unknown
): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return (
    typeof value === "object" &&
    value !== null &&
    !Array.isArray(value)
  );
}

function isIncomingEvent(
  value: unknown
): value is IncomingMonitorEvent {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return false;

  const hasValidFields =
    typeof value.source === "string" &&
    VALID_SOURCES.has(value.source) &&

    typeof value.severity === "string" &&
    VALID_SEVERITIES.has(value.severity) &&

    typeof value.signal === "string" &&
    VALID_SIGNALS.has(value.signal) &&

    typeof value.confidence === "string" &&
    VALID_CONFIDENCE.has(value.confidence) &&

    typeof value.message === "string" &&
    value.message.trim().length > 0 &&
    value.message.length <= 500 &&

    typeof value.matchedText === "string" &&
    value.matchedText.trim().length > 0 &&
    value.matchedText.length <= 800 &&

    typeof value.url === "string" &&
    VALID_URLS.has(value.url);

  if (!hasValidFields) return false;

  const source = value.source as IncomingMonitorEvent["source"];
  const severity = value.severity as IncomingMonitorEvent["severity"];
  const signal = value.signal as IncomingMonitorEvent["signal"];
  const url = value.url as string;

  // Validação de consistência entre severity e signal (Problema 5)
  if (EXPECTED_SIGNAL_BY_SEVERITY[severity] !== signal) {
    return false;
  }

  // Validação de consistência entre source e url
  if (EXPECTED_URL_BY_SOURCE[source] !== url) {
    return false;
  }

  return true;
}

function isStoredEvent(
  value: unknown
): value is StoredMonitorEvent {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return false;

  const validSignal =
    value.signal === undefined ||
    (
      typeof value.signal === "string" &&
      VALID_SIGNALS.has(value.signal)
    );

  const validConfidence =
    value.confidence === undefined ||
    (
      typeof value.confidence === "string" &&
      VALID_CONFIDENCE.has(value.confidence)
    );

  return (
    typeof value.source === "string" &&
    VALID_SOURCES.has(value.source) &&

    typeof value.severity === "string" &&
    VALID_SEVERITIES.has(value.severity) &&

    validSignal &&
    validConfidence &&

    typeof value.message === "string" &&
    typeof value.matchedText === "string" &&
    typeof value.url === "string" &&
    typeof value.observedAt === "string"
  );
}

function isRecentDuplicate(
  events: StoredMonitorEvent[],
  incoming: IncomingMonitorEvent,
  nowMs: number
): StoredMonitorEvent | null {
  for (let i = events.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
    const existing = events[i];
    if (!existing) continue;

    const observedMs = Date.parse(existing.observedAt);
    if (Number.isNaN(observedMs)) continue;

    if (nowMs - observedMs > SERVER_DEDUP_WINDOW_MS) {
      break;
    }

    if (
      existing.source === incoming.source &&
      existing.severity === incoming.severity &&
      existing.signal === incoming.signal &&
      existing.matchedText === incoming.matchedText
    ) {
      return existing;
    }
  }

  return null;
}

// ============================================
// RESPOSTAS HTTP
// ============================================

function isMozExtensionOrigin(origin: string | undefined): origin is string {
  return Boolean(origin && MOZ_EXTENSION_ORIGIN_REGEX.test(origin));
}

function sendJson(
  response: ServerResponse,
  status: number,
  data: unknown,
  origin?: string
): void {
  response.writeHead(status, {
    "Content-Type": "application/json; charset=utf-8",
    "Cache-Control": "no-store",

    ...(isMozExtensionOrigin(origin)
      ? {
          "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": origin,
          "Vary": "Origin"
        }
      : {})
  });

  response.end(JSON.stringify(data));
}

// ============================================
// HISTÓRICO DE EVENTOS
// ============================================

async function readEvents(): Promise<StoredMonitorEvent[]> {
  let content: string;

  try {
    content = await readFile(EVENTS_FILE, "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if (
      isRecord(error) &&
      error.code === "ENOENT"
    ) {
      return [];
    }

    throw error;
  }

  const cleanContent = content.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim();

  if (!cleanContent) {
    return [];
  }

  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(cleanContent);

  if (
    !Array.isArray(parsed) ||
    !parsed.every(isStoredEvent)
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "O arquivo de histórico possui uma estrutura inválida."
    );
  }

  return parsed;
}

// ============================================
// GRAVAÇÃO SEGURA
// ============================================

async function writeEventsAtomically(
  events: StoredMonitorEvent[]
): Promise<void> {
  const temporaryFile =
    `${EVENTS_FILE}.${process.pid}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`;

  try {
    await writeFile(
      temporaryFile,
      JSON.stringify(events.slice(-MAX_HISTORY), null, 2),
      "utf8"
    );

    await rename(temporaryFile, EVENTS_FILE);
  } finally {
    await rm(temporaryFile, { force: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

// ============================================
// FILA DE GRAVAÇÃO
// ============================================

let writeQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();

function withEventLock<T>(
  operation: () => Promise<T>
): Promise<T> {
  const result = writeQueue.then(
    operation,
    operation
  );

  writeQueue = result.then(
    () => undefined,
    () => undefined
  );

  return result;
}

// ============================================
// LEITURA DO CORPO HTTP
// ============================================

async function readRequestBody(
  request: IncomingMessage
): Promise<string> {
  const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
  let totalSize = 0;

  for await (const chunk of request) {
    const buffer = Buffer.isBuffer(chunk)
      ? chunk
      : Buffer.from(chunk);

    totalSize += buffer.length;

    if (totalSize > MAX_BODY_SIZE) {
      throw new Error(
        "Corpo da requisição muito grande."
      );
    }

    chunks.push(buffer);
  }

  return Buffer.concat(chunks).toString("utf8");
}

// ============================================
// VALIDAÇÃO DE ORIGEM
// ============================================

function isAllowedOrigin(
  origin: string | undefined
): boolean {
  if (!origin) return true;

  if (origin === DASHBOARD_ORIGIN) {
    return true;
  }

  return isMozExtensionOrigin(origin);
}

// ============================================
// AUTORIZAÇÃO DO DASHBOARD / TOKEN
// ============================================

function isDashboardRequest(
  request: IncomingMessage
): boolean {
  const origin = request.headers.origin;
  const fetchSite = request.headers["sec-fetch-site"];
  const host = request.headers.host;

  return (
    host === `${HOST}:${PORT}` &&
    fetchSite === "same-origin" &&
    (
      origin === undefined ||
      origin === DASHBOARD_ORIGIN
    )
  );
}

function isAuthorizedLocalClient(
  request: IncomingMessage
): boolean {
  const suppliedToken = request.headers["x-ai-council-token"];
  const authorizedByToken = suppliedToken === TOKEN;
  const authorizedByDashboard = isDashboardRequest(request);

  return authorizedByToken || authorizedByDashboard;
}

// ============================================
// ARQUIVOS DO DASHBOARD
// ============================================

async function serveDashboard(
  pathname: string,
  response: ServerResponse
): Promise<void> {
  const files: Record<string, string> = {
    "/": "index.html",
    "/index.html": "index.html",
    "/styles.css": "styles.css",
    "/dashboard.js": "dashboard.js"
  };

  const filename = files[pathname];

  if (!filename) {
    sendJson(response, 404, {
      error: "Arquivo não encontrado."
    });
    return;
  }

  const filePath = resolve(PUBLIC_DIR, filename);

  if (!filePath.startsWith(PUBLIC_DIR + sep)) {
    sendJson(response, 403, {
      error: "Acesso negado."
    });
    return;
  }

  try {
    const content = await readFile(filePath);

    response.writeHead(200, {
      "Content-Type":
        MIME_TYPES[extname(filePath)] ??
        "application/octet-stream",
      "Cache-Control": "no-store",
      "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff"
    });

    response.end(content);
  } catch {
    sendJson(response, 404, {
      error: "Arquivo não encontrado."
    });
  }
}

// ============================================
// SERVIDOR
// ============================================

async function main(): Promise<void> {
  if (!TOKEN || TOKEN.length < 32) {
    throw new Error(
      "MONITOR_TOKEN ausente ou inválido no arquivo .env."
    );
  }

  await mkdir(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });

  const server = createServer(
    async (request, response) => {
      const origin = request.headers.origin;

      // ----------------------------------------
      // VALIDAÇÃO DA ORIGEM
      // ----------------------------------------

      if (!isAllowedOrigin(origin)) {
        sendJson(response, 403, {
          error: "Origem não autorizada."
        });

        return;
      }

      // ----------------------------------------
      // CORS
      // ----------------------------------------

      if (request.method === "OPTIONS") {
        if (!isMozExtensionOrigin(origin)) {
          sendJson(response, 403, {
            error: "Preflight não autorizado."
          });

          return;
        }

        response.writeHead(204, {
          "Access-Control-Allow-Origin": origin,
          "Access-Control-Allow-Methods": "GET, POST, OPTIONS",
          "Access-Control-Allow-Headers":
            "Content-Type, X-AI-Council-Token",
          "Access-Control-Max-Age": "600",
          "Vary": "Origin"
        });

        response.end();
        return;
      }

      const url = new URL(
        request.url ?? "/",
        DASHBOARD_ORIGIN
      );

      // ----------------------------------------
      // DASHBOARD
      // ----------------------------------------

      const dashboardFiles = new Set([
        "/",
        "/index.html",
        "/styles.css",
        "/dashboard.js"
      ]);

      if (dashboardFiles.has(url.pathname)) {
        if (request.method !== "GET") {
          sendJson(response, 405, {
            error: "Método não permitido."
          }, origin);

          return;
        }

        await serveDashboard(url.pathname, response);
        return;
      }

      // ----------------------------------------
      // HEALTH CHECK
      // ----------------------------------------

      if (
        request.method === "GET" &&
        url.pathname === "/health"
      ) {
        sendJson(response, 200, {
          status: "online",
          service: "ai-council-usage-monitor",
          timestamp: new Date().toISOString()
        }, origin);

        return;
      }

      // ----------------------------------------
      // STATUS, HISTÓRICO E DEBATES
      // ----------------------------------------

      if (
        request.method === "GET" &&
        url.pathname === "/status"
      ) {
        if (!isAuthorizedLocalClient(request)) {
          sendJson(response, 401, {
            error: "Não autorizado."
          }, origin);

          return;
        }

        try {
          const [events, debates] = await Promise.all([
            readEvents(),
            listDebateSessions()
          ]);

          const activeDebatesCount = debates.filter(
            (d) => d.status === "running"
          ).length;

          // Trava de segurança: a extensão de navegador (legado) usa o token e
          // lia as tarefas pendentes para automatizar o ChatGPT/Claude pela
          // interface web, o que pode violar os termos de uso. Só o painel
          // (mesma origem) recebe as tarefas pendentes.
          const visibleDebates = isDashboardRequest(request)
            ? debates
            : debates.map((debate) => ({
                ...debate,
                tasks: debate.tasks.filter((task) => task.status !== "pending")
              }));

          sendJson(response, 200, {
            status: "online",
            totalEvents: events.length,
            latestEvents: events.slice(-20),
            activeDebatesCount,
            debates: visibleDebates
          }, origin);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(
            "[AI Council] Erro ao ler status:",
            error
          );

          sendJson(response, 500, {
            error: "Não foi possível ler o histórico ou estado."
          }, origin);
        }

        return;
      }

      // ----------------------------------------
      // PROVEDORES (API) E USO DIÁRIO
      // ----------------------------------------

      if (
        request.method === "GET" &&
        url.pathname === "/providers"
      ) {
        if (!isAuthorizedLocalClient(request)) {
          sendJson(response, 401, {
            error: "Não autorizado."
          }, origin);

          return;
        }

        try {
          sendJson(response, 200, {
            providers: await getProvidersStatus()
          }, origin);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error("[AI Council] Erro ao ler provedores:", error);

          sendJson(response, 500, {
            error: "Não foi possível ler o estado dos provedores."
          }, origin);
        }

        return;
      }

      // ----------------------------------------
      // LISTAR OU CRIAR DEBATES (/debates)
      // ----------------------------------------

      if (url.pathname === "/debates") {
        if (!isAuthorizedLocalClient(request)) {
          sendJson(response, 401, {
            error: "Não autorizado."
          }, origin);

          return;
        }

        if (request.method === "GET") {
          try {
            const debates = await listDebateSessions();
            sendJson(response, 200, { debates }, origin);
          } catch (error) {
            console.error("[AI Council] Erro ao listar debates:", error);
            sendJson(response, 500, {
              error: "Falha ao listar debates."
            }, origin);
          }
          return;
        }

        if (request.method === "POST") {
          let payload: unknown;

          try {
            const body = await readRequestBody(request);
            payload = JSON.parse(body);
          } catch {
            sendJson(response, 400, {
              error: "Corpo da requisição inválido."
            }, origin);
            return;
          }

          if (!isRecord(payload)) {
            sendJson(response, 400, {
              error: "Dados do debate inválidos."
            }, origin);
            return;
          }

          const rawParticipants = Array.isArray(payload.participants)
            ? payload.participants.filter(
                (p): p is AIPlatform =>
                  typeof p === "string" && VALID_PARTICIPANTS.has(p)
              )
            : [];

          try {
            const session = await createDebateSession({
              title: typeof payload.title === "string" ? payload.title : "",
              topic: typeof payload.topic === "string" ? payload.topic : "",
              rules: typeof payload.rules === "string" ? payload.rules : undefined,
              participants: rawParticipants,
              totalRounds: Number(payload.totalRounds) || 2,
              focus:
                payload.focus === "backend" || payload.focus === "frontend"
                  ? payload.focus
                  : "geral"
            });

            console.log(
              "[AI Council] Debate criado:",
              session.id,
              session.title
            );

            // Os assentos automáticos começam a responder imediatamente.
            kickRunner();

            sendJson(response, 201, {
              created: true,
              debate: session
            }, origin);
          } catch (error) {
            sendJson(response, 400, {
              error:
                error instanceof Error
                  ? error.message
                  : "Não foi possível criar o debate."
            }, origin);
          }

          return;
        }
      }

      // ----------------------------------------
      // AÇÕES EM UM DEBATE (/debates/:id/:action)
      // ----------------------------------------

      const debateActionMatch = url.pathname.match(
        /^\/debates\/([0-9a-fA-F-]{36})\/(respond|pause|resume)$/
      );

      if (debateActionMatch && request.method === "POST") {
        if (!isAuthorizedLocalClient(request)) {
          sendJson(response, 401, {
            error: "Não autorizado."
          }, origin);

          return;
        }

        const debateId = debateActionMatch[1] ?? "";
        const action = debateActionMatch[2] ?? "";

        let payload: Record<string, unknown> = {};

        try {
          const body = await readRequestBody(request);
          if (body.trim()) {
            const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(body);
            if (isRecord(parsed)) {
              payload = parsed;
            }
          }
        } catch {
          sendJson(response, 400, {
            error: "Corpo da requisição inválido."
          }, origin);
          return;
        }

        try {
          if (action === "respond") {
            const taskId =
              typeof payload.taskId === "string" ? payload.taskId : "";
            const content =
              typeof payload.content === "string" ? payload.content : "";

            const updated = await submitDebateTaskResponse(debateId, {
              taskId,
              content
            });

            // Se a próxima etapa tiver assentos automáticos, o runner assume.
            kickRunner();

            sendJson(response, 200, {
              updated: true,
              debate: updated
            }, origin);
            return;
          }

          if (action === "pause") {
            const reason =
              typeof payload.reason === "string"
                ? payload.reason
                : undefined;

            const updated = await pauseDebateManually(debateId, reason);

            sendJson(response, 200, {
              updated: true,
              debate: updated
            }, origin);
            return;
          }

          if (action === "resume") {
            const updated = await resumeDebateSession(debateId);

            kickRunner();

            sendJson(response, 200, {
              updated: true,
              debate: updated
            }, origin);
            return;
          }
        } catch (error) {
          sendJson(response, 400, {
            error:
              error instanceof Error
                ? error.message
                : "Erro ao atualizar o debate."
          }, origin);
          return;
        }
      }

      // ----------------------------------------
      // RECEBIMENTO DE EVENTOS DE LIMITE
      // ----------------------------------------

      if (
        request.method === "POST" &&
        url.pathname === "/events"
      ) {
        if (
          request.headers["x-ai-council-token"] !== TOKEN
        ) {
          sendJson(response, 401, {
            error: "Não autorizado."
          }, origin);

          return;
        }

        let event: unknown;

        try {
          const body = await readRequestBody(request);
          event = JSON.parse(body);
        } catch {
          sendJson(response, 400, {
            error: "Corpo da requisição inválido."
          }, origin);

          return;
        }

        if (!isIncomingEvent(event)) {
          sendJson(response, 400, {
            error: "Evento inválido ou campos incompatíveis."
          }, origin);

          return;
        }

        try {
          const result = await withEventLock(
            async () => {
              const events = await readEvents();
              const now = new Date();

              const duplicate = isRecentDuplicate(
                events,
                event,
                now.getTime()
              );

              if (duplicate) {
                return {
                  deduplicated: true,
                  event: duplicate
                };
              }

              const newEvent: StoredMonitorEvent = {
                ...event,
                observedAt: now.toISOString()
              };

              events.push(newEvent);

              await writeEventsAtomically(events);

              return {
                deduplicated: false,
                event: newEvent
              };
            }
          );

          // Proteção financeira e controle de sessão (Seção 2 e Seção 12):
          // Propaga o sinal de limite para pausar debates ativos caso severity === "blocked".
          const debateImpact = await applyLimitSignalToDebates(
            result.event.source,
            result.event.severity,
            result.event.matchedText,
            result.event.observedAt
          );

          if (debateImpact.pausedDebateIds.length > 0) {
            console.warn(
              "[AI Council] Debates pausados automaticamente por limite atingido:",
              debateImpact.pausedDebateIds.join(", ")
            );
          }

          if (result.deduplicated) {
            console.log(
              "[AI Council] Evento duplicado ignorado:",
              result.event.source,
              result.event.severity,
              result.event.signal
            );

            sendJson(response, 200, {
              saved: true,
              deduplicated: true,
              pausedDebates: debateImpact.pausedDebateIds,
              event: result.event
            }, origin);

            return;
          }

          console.log(
            "[AI Council] Evento armazenado:",
            result.event.source,
            result.event.severity,
            result.event.signal
          );

          sendJson(response, 201, {
            saved: true,
            pausedDebates: debateImpact.pausedDebateIds,
            event: result.event
          }, origin);
        } catch (error) {
          console.error(
            "[AI Council] Erro ao salvar evento:",
            error
          );

          sendJson(response, 500, {
            error: "Não foi possível salvar o evento."
          }, origin);
        }

        return;
      }

      // ----------------------------------------
      // ROTA NÃO ENCONTRADA
      // ----------------------------------------

      sendJson(response, 404, {
        error: "Rota não encontrada."
      }, origin);
    }
  );

  server.listen(PORT, HOST, () => {
    console.log(
      `AI Council Usage Monitor ativo em http://${HOST}:${PORT}`
    );

    // Assentos automáticos (Gemini, Groq, OpenRouter) respondem sozinhos.
    startRunner();
  });
}

// ============================================
// INICIALIZAÇÃO
// ============================================

main().catch((error: unknown) => {
  console.error(
    "Falha ao iniciar monitor:",
    error instanceof Error
      ? error.message
      : "Erro desconhecido"
  );

  process.exitCode = 1;
});

import {
  mkdir,
  readFile,
  writeFile,
  rename,
  rm
} from "node:fs/promises";

import { randomUUID } from "node:crypto";
import { dirname, resolve } from "node:path";
import { fileURLToPath } from "node:url";

import type { DebateSession } from "../shared/debate-types.js";

const ROOT_DIR = resolve(dirname(fileURLToPath(import.meta.url)), "../..");
const DATA_DIR = resolve(ROOT_DIR, "data");
const DEBATES_FILE = resolve(DATA_DIR, "debates.json");

let debateWriteQueue: Promise<void> = Promise.resolve();

function isRecord(value: unknown): value is Record<string, unknown> {
  return (
    typeof value === "object" &&
    value !== null &&
    !Array.isArray(value)
  );
}

function isStoredDebateSession(value: unknown): value is DebateSession {
  if (!isRecord(value)) return false;

  return (
    typeof value.id === "string" &&
    typeof value.title === "string" &&
    typeof value.topic === "string" &&
    typeof value.rules === "string" &&
    Array.isArray(value.participants) &&
    typeof value.totalRounds === "number" &&
    typeof value.currentRound === "number" &&
    typeof value.currentStage === "string" &&
    typeof value.status === "string" &&
    isRecord(value.participantStates) &&
    Array.isArray(value.tasks) &&
    Array.isArray(value.responses) &&
    typeof value.createdAt === "string" &&
    typeof value.updatedAt === "string"
  );
}

export function withDebateLock<T>(
  operation: () => Promise<T>
): Promise<T> {
  const result = debateWriteQueue.then(operation, operation);

  debateWriteQueue = result.then(
    () => undefined,
    () => undefined
  );

  return result;
}

export async function readDebateSessions(): Promise<DebateSession[]> {
  await mkdir(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });

  let content: string;

  try {
    content = await readFile(DEBATES_FILE, "utf8");
  } catch (error) {
    if (isRecord(error) && error.code === "ENOENT") {
      return [];
    }
    throw error;
  }

 const cleanContent = content.replace(/^\uFEFF/, "").trim();

  if (!cleanContent) {
    return [];
  }

  const parsed: unknown = JSON.parse(cleanContent);

  if (
    !Array.isArray(parsed) ||
    !parsed.every(isStoredDebateSession)
  ) {
    throw new Error(
      "O arquivo data/debates.json possui uma estrutura inválida."
    );
  }

  return parsed;
}

export async function writeDebateSessionsAtomically(
  sessions: DebateSession[]
): Promise<void> {
  await mkdir(DATA_DIR, { recursive: true });

  const temporaryFile =
    `${DEBATES_FILE}.${process.pid}.${randomUUID()}.tmp`;

  try {
    await writeFile(
      temporaryFile,
      JSON.stringify(sessions, null, 2),
      "utf8"
    );

    await rename(temporaryFile, DEBATES_FILE);
  } finally {
    await rm(temporaryFile, { force: true }).catch(() => {});
  }
}

import { GoogleGenAI } from "@google/genai";

import { runWithFallback } from "./policy.js";
import type { Provider } from "./types.js";
import type { UsageGate } from "./usage-gate.js";

export interface GeminiOptions {
  apiKey: string;
  models: readonly string[];
  gate: UsageGate;
  maxHttpAttempts: number;

  /** Apenas para testes locais com servidor falso. */
  baseUrl?: string;
}

/** Modelos 2.5 Flash aceitam desligar o "thinking" (economiza tokens e evita resposta cortada). */
function canDisableThinking(model: string): boolean {
  return /^gemini-2\.5-flash/.test(model);
}

export function makeGemini(options: GeminiOptions): Provider {
  const ai = new GoogleGenAI({
    apiKey: options.apiKey,
    httpOptions: {
      timeout: 90_000,
      // Por padrão o SDK tenta até 5 vezes sozinho. Aqui é 1 só: as
      // retentativas são controladas (e contadas) pelo UsageGate.
      retryOptions: { attempts: 1 },
      ...(options.baseUrl ? { baseUrl: options.baseUrl } : {})
    }
  });

  return {
    id: "gemini",
    name: "Gemini",
    models: options.models,

    async generate(request) {
      return runWithFallback({
        models: options.models,
        maxHttpAttempts: options.maxHttpAttempts,
        gate: options.gate,
        request,
        headroom: 1_000,
        call: async (model) => {
          const noThinking = canDisableThinking(model);

          const response = await ai.models.generateContent({
            model,
            contents: request.user,
            config: {
              systemInstruction: request.system,
              maxOutputTokens: request.maxTokens + (noThinking ? 0 : 1_500),
              temperature: 0.4,
              ...(noThinking ? { thinkingConfig: { thinkingBudget: 0 } } : {})
            }
          });

          return {
            text: response.text ?? "",
            inputTokens: response.usageMetadata?.promptTokenCount,
            outputTokens: response.usageMetadata?.candidatesTokenCount,
            totalTokens: response.usageMetadata?.totalTokenCount
          };
        }
      });
    }
  };
}

ARQUIVO: ./src/providers/openai-compat.ts

import OpenAI from "openai";

import type { AutoPlatform } from "../shared/debate-types.js";
import { runWithFallback } from "./policy.js";
import type { Provider } from "./types.js";
import type { UsageGate } from "./usage-gate.js";

export interface OpenAICompatOptions {
  id: AutoPlatform;
  name: string;
  apiKey: string;
  baseURL: string;
  models: readonly string[];
  gate: UsageGate;
  maxHttpAttempts: number;

  /** Groq usa max_completion_tokens; OpenRouter usa max_tokens. */
  maxTokensParam: "max_tokens" | "max_completion_tokens";

  /** Margem extra para modelos que "pensam" antes de responder. */
  tokenHeadroom?: number;

  extraBody?: (model: string) => Record<string, unknown>;
  extraHeaders?: Record<string, string>;
}

/** Provedor para qualquer API compatível com o SDK da OpenAI (Groq, OpenRouter...). */
export function makeOpenAICompat(options: OpenAICompatOptions): Provider {
  const client = new OpenAI({
    apiKey: options.apiKey,
    baseURL: options.baseURL,
    // Sem retentativas escondidas do SDK: cada chamada HTTP passa pelo UsageGate.
    maxRetries: 0,
    timeout: 90_000,
    defaultHeaders: options.extraHeaders
  });

  const headroom = options.tokenHeadroom ?? 0;

  return {
    id: options.id,
    name: options.name,
    models: options.models,

    async generate(request) {
      return runWithFallback({
        models: options.models,
        maxHttpAttempts: options.maxHttpAttempts,
        gate: options.gate,
        request,
        headroom,
        call: async (model) => {
          const params = {
            model,
            messages: [
              { role: "system", content: request.system },
              { role: "user", content: request.user }
            ],
            [options.maxTokensParam]: request.maxTokens + headroom,
            ...(options.extraBody ? options.extraBody(model) : {})
          } as unknown as OpenAI.Chat.ChatCompletionCreateParamsNonStreaming;

          const response = await client.chat.completions.create(params);

          return {
            text: response.choices[0]?.message?.content ?? "",
            inputTokens: response.usage?.prompt_tokens,
            outputTokens: response.usage?.completion_tokens,
            totalTokens: response.usage?.total_tokens
          };
        }
      });
    }
  };
}

ARQUIVO: ./src/providers/policy.ts
========================================
import type { UsageGate } from "./usage-gate.js";
import {
  ProviderError,
  classifyError,
  type GenerateRequest,
  type GenerateResult
} from "./types.js";

const MAX_RETRY_AFTER_MS = 30_000;

function sleep(ms: number): Promise<void> {
  return new Promise((resolveSleep) => setTimeout(resolveSleep, ms));
}

/** Estimativa conservadora (≈3 caracteres por token) do consumo de uma chamada. */
export function estimateTokens(
  request: GenerateRequest,
  headroom = 0
): number {
  const inputChars = request.system.length + request.user.length;
  return Math.ceil(inputChars / 3) + request.maxTokens + headroom;
}

export interface ModelCallResult {
  text: string;
  inputTokens?: number;
  outputTokens?: number;
  totalTokens?: number;
}

/**
 * Executa uma chamada com limite RÍGIDO de tentativas HTTP.
 *
 * - Cada tentativa passa pelo UsageGate (conta no limite diário local).
 * - A tentativa seguinte usa o próximo modelo da lista (cicla se houver um só).
 * - Erros de chave (401/403) e de cota (402, limite diário) interrompem na hora.
 * - Nunca há retentativas escondidas: o SDK é criado com maxRetries = 0.
 */
export async function runWithFallback(args: {
  models: readonly string[];
  maxHttpAttempts: number;
  gate: UsageGate;
  request: GenerateRequest;
  headroom?: number;
  call: (model: string) => Promise<ModelCallResult>;
}): Promise<GenerateResult> {
  const { models, maxHttpAttempts, gate, request, call } = args;

  if (models.length === 0) {
    throw new ProviderError("model", "Nenhum modelo configurado para este provedor.");
  }

  const estimate = estimateTokens(request, args.headroom ?? 0);
  let lastError: ProviderError | null = null;

  for (let attempt = 0; attempt < maxHttpAttempts; attempt++) {
    const model = models[attempt % models.length] as string;
    const ticket = await gate.acquire(estimate);

    try {
      const result = await call(model);
      const text = result.text.trim();

      ticket.settle(result.totalTokens ?? estimate);

      if (!text) {
        lastError = new ProviderError("empty", `Resposta vazia do modelo ${model}.`);
      } else {
        return {
          text,
          model,
          inputTokens: result.inputTokens,
          outputTokens: result.outputTokens,
          totalTokens: result.totalTokens
        };
      }
    } catch (error) {
      ticket.settle(0);
      const classified = classifyError(error);
      lastError = classified;

      if (classified.kind === "auth" || classified.kind === "quota_exhausted") {
        throw classified;
      }

      if (
        classified.kind === "rate_limit" &&
        classified.retryAfterMs !== undefined &&
        classified.retryAfterMs > MAX_RETRY_AFTER_MS
      ) {
        throw classified;
      }

      if (attempt + 1 < maxHttpAttempts) {
        const delay =
          classified.kind === "rate_limit"
            ? Math.min(classified.retryAfterMs ?? 3_000, MAX_RETRY_AFTER_MS)
            : classified.kind === "transient"
              ? 1_500 * (attempt + 1)
              : 300;

        await sleep(delay);
      }
    }
  }

  throw (
    lastError ??
    new ProviderError("unknown", "Falha desconhecida ao chamar o provedor.")
  );
}

import "dotenv/config";

import type { AutoPlatform } from "../shared/debate-types.js";
import { makeGemini } from "./gemini.js";
import { makeOpenAICompat } from "./openai-compat.js";
import type { Provider } from "./types.js";
import { UsageGate, type GateSnapshot } from "./usage-gate.js";

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Leitura de configuração (.env)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

function envString(name: string): string | undefined {
  const value = process.env[name]?.trim();
  return value ? value : undefined;
}

function envInt(name: string, fallback: number): number {
  const raw = envString(name);
  if (raw === undefined) return fallback;

  const parsed = Number(raw);
  return Number.isFinite(parsed) && parsed > 0 ? Math.floor(parsed) : fallback;
}

function envList(name: string, fallback: string[]): string[] {
  const raw = envString(name);
  if (raw === undefined) return fallback;

  const items = raw
    .split(",")
    .map((item) => item.trim())
    .filter(Boolean);

  return items.length > 0 ? items : fallback;
}

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Padrões (podem ser trocados no .env sem mexer no código)
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

const DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODELS = ["gemini-3.5-flash-lite", "gemini-3.5-flash"];
const DEFAULT_GROQ_MODELS = ["openai/gpt-oss-120b", "openai/gpt-oss-20b"];
const DEFAULT_OPENROUTER_MODELS = [
  "nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b:free",
  "google/gemma-4-31b-it:free",
  "cohere/north-mini-code:free"
];

const PLATFORM_LABELS: Record<AutoPlatform, string> = {
  gemini: "Gemini",
  groq: "Groq",
  openrouter: "OpenRouter"
};

// ---------------------------------------------------------------
// Estado
// ---------------------------------------------------------------

const providers = new Map<AutoPlatform, Provider>();
const gates = new Map<AutoPlatform, UsageGate>();
const issues = new Map<AutoPlatform, string>();
const configuredModels = new Map<AutoPlatform, string[]>();
let initialized = false;

function safetyFactor(): number {
  const raw = Number(envString("USAGE_SAFETY") ?? "0.9");
  return Number.isFinite(raw) && raw > 0 && raw <= 1 ? raw : 0.9;
}

function initGemini(): void {
  const models = envList("GEMINI_MODELS", [
    envString("GEMINI_MODEL") ?? DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODELS[0] ?? "gemini-2.5-flash",
    ...envList("GEMINI_FALLBACK_MODELS", DEFAULT_GEMINI_MODELS.slice(1))
  ]);

  configuredModels.set("gemini", models);

  const apiKey = envString("GEMINI_API_KEY");
  if (!apiKey) {
    issues.set("gemini", "GEMINI_API_KEY ausente no .env.");
    return;
  }

  // O Google não publica mais os limites gratuitos por modelo na documentação:
  // confira o console do AI Studio e ajuste estes valores no .env se precisar.
  const gate = new UsageGate(
    "gemini",
    {
      rpm: envInt("GEMINI_RPM", 5),
      rpd: envInt("GEMINI_RPD", 100),
      tpm: envInt("GEMINI_TPM", 200_000)
    },
    "America/Los_Angeles",
    safetyFactor()
  );

  gates.set("gemini", gate);

  providers.set(
    "gemini",
    makeGemini({
      apiKey,
      models,
      gate,
      maxHttpAttempts: envInt("GEMINI_MAX_ATTEMPTS", 2),
      baseUrl: envString("GEMINI_BASE_URL")
    })
  );
}

function initGroq(): void {
  const models = envList("GROQ_MODELS", [
    envString("GROQ_MODEL") ?? DEFAULT_GROQ_MODELS[0] ?? "openai/gpt-oss-120b",
    ...envList("GROQ_FALLBACK_MODELS", DEFAULT_GROQ_MODELS.slice(1))
  ]);

  configuredModels.set("groq", models);

  const apiKey = envString("GROQ_API_KEY");
  if (!apiKey) {
    issues.set("groq", "GROQ_API_KEY ausente no .env.");
    return;
  }

  // Limites do plano gratuito para gpt-oss-120b (por organização).
  // A página de limites da sua conta na Groq é a referência final.
  const gate = new UsageGate(
    "groq",
    {
      rpm: envInt("GROQ_RPM", 30),
      rpd: envInt("GROQ_RPD", 1000),
      tpm: envInt("GROQ_TPM", 8000),
      tpd: envInt("GROQ_TPD", 200_000)
    },
    "UTC",
    safetyFactor()
  );

  gates.set("groq", gate);

  providers.set(
    "groq",
    makeOpenAICompat({
      id: "groq",
      name: "Groq",
      apiKey,
      baseURL: envString("GROQ_BASE_URL") ?? "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1",
      models,
      gate,
      maxHttpAttempts: envInt("GROQ_MAX_ATTEMPTS", 2),
      maxTokensParam: "max_completion_tokens",
      tokenHeadroom: 600,
      extraBody: (model) =>
        model.startsWith("openai/gpt-oss") ? { reasoning_effort: "low" } : {}
    })
  );
}

function initOpenRouter(): void {
  const models = envList("OPENROUTER_MODELS", DEFAULT_OPENROUTER_MODELS);
  configuredModels.set("openrouter", models);

  const apiKey = envString("OPENROUTER_API_KEY");
  if (!apiKey) {
    issues.set("openrouter", "OPENROUTER_API_KEY ausente no .env.");
    return;
  }

  // PROTEÇÃO CONTRA GASTO: só aceita modelos gratuitos (ID terminando em :free).
  const paid = models.filter((model) => !model.endsWith(":free"));
  if (paid.length > 0) {
    issues.set(
      "openrouter",
      `Recusado por segurança: estes modelos não são gratuitos (sem :free): ${paid.join(", ")}.`
    );
    return;
  }

  const gate = new UsageGate(
    "openrouter",
    {
      rpm: envInt("OPENROUTER_RPM", 20),
      // 50/dia vale enquanto você nunca tiver comprado créditos.
      rpd: envInt("OPENROUTER_RPD", 50)
    },
    "UTC",
    safetyFactor()
  );

  gates.set("openrouter", gate);

  providers.set(
    "openrouter",
    makeOpenAICompat({
      id: "openrouter",
      name: "OpenRouter",
      apiKey,
      baseURL: envString("OPENROUTER_BASE_URL") ?? "https://openrouter.ai/api/v1",
      models,
      gate,
      // Cada tentativa gasta 1 das 50 requisições diárias: no máximo 3, com troca de modelo.
      maxHttpAttempts: envInt("OPENROUTER_MAX_ATTEMPTS", 3),
      maxTokensParam: "max_tokens",
      tokenHeadroom: 400,
      extraHeaders: { "X-Title": "AI Council" }
    })
  );
}

export function initProviders(): void {
  if (initialized) return;
  initialized = true;

  initGemini();
  initGroq();
  initOpenRouter();
}

export function getProvider(id: AutoPlatform): Provider | null {
  initProviders();
  return providers.get(id) ?? null;
}

export function getProviderIssue(id: AutoPlatform): string | null {
  initProviders();
  return issues.get(id) ?? null;
}

export function getProviderLabel(id: AutoPlatform): string {
  return PLATFORM_LABELS[id];
}

export interface ProviderStatus {
  id: AutoPlatform;
  name: string;
  ready: boolean;
  reason: string | null;
  models: string[];
  usage: GateSnapshot | null;
}

export async function getProvidersStatus(): Promise<ProviderStatus[]> {
  initProviders();

  const ids: AutoPlatform[] = ["gemini", "groq", "openrouter"];
  const result: ProviderStatus[] = [];

  for (const id of ids) {
    const gate = gates.get(id);

    result.push({
      id,
      name: PLATFORM_LABELS[id],
      ready: providers.has(id),
      reason: issues.get(id) ?? null,
      models: configuredModels.get(id) ?? [],
      usage: gate ? await gate.snapshot() : null
    });
  }

  return result;
}

ARQUIVO: ./src/providers/types.ts

import type { AutoPlatform } from "../shared/debate-types.js";

export interface GenerateRequest {
  system: string;
  user: string;
  maxTokens: number;
}

export interface GenerateResult {
  text: string;
  model: string;
  inputTokens?: number;
  outputTokens?: number;
  totalTokens?: number;
}

export type ProviderErrorKind =
  | "rate_limit"
  | "quota_exhausted"
  | "auth"
  | "model"
  | "transient"
  | "empty"
  | "unknown";

export class ProviderError extends Error {
  readonly kind: ProviderErrorKind;
  readonly status?: number;
  readonly retryAfterMs?: number;

  constructor(
    kind: ProviderErrorKind,
    message: string,
    options: { status?: number; retryAfterMs?: number } = {}
  ) {
    super(message);
    this.name = "ProviderError";
    this.kind = kind;
    this.status = options.status;
    this.retryAfterMs = options.retryAfterMs;
  }
}

export interface Provider {
  readonly id: AutoPlatform;
  readonly name: string;
  readonly models: readonly string[];
  generate(request: GenerateRequest): Promise<GenerateResult>;
}

function asRecord(value: unknown): Record<string, unknown> | null {
  return typeof value === "object" && value !== null
    ? (value as Record<string, unknown>)
    : null;
}

function readHeader(headers: unknown, name: string): string | null {
  if (!headers) return null;

  const withGet = asRecord(headers);

  if (withGet && typeof withGet.get === "function") {
    const value = (withGet.get as (key: string) => unknown).call(headers, name);
    return typeof value === "string" ? value : null;
  }

  if (withGet) {
    const value = withGet[name] ?? withGet[name.toLowerCase()];
    return typeof value === "string" ? value : null;
  }

  return null;
}

function parseRetryAfterMs(error: unknown, message: string): number | undefined {
  const record = asRecord(error);
  const header = readHeader(record?.headers, "retry-after");

  if (header) {
    const seconds = Number(header);
    if (Number.isFinite(seconds) && seconds >= 0) {
      return Math.ceil(seconds * 1000);
    }
  }

  // Gemini costuma informar "retryDelay": "34s" dentro da mensagem de erro.
  const match = message.match(/"retryDelay"\s*:\s*"(\d+(?:\.\d+)?)s"/i);
  if (match?.[1]) {
    return Math.ceil(Number(match[1]) * 1000);
  }

  return undefined;
}

/** Converte qualquer erro de SDK/rede em um ProviderError com categoria previsível. */
export function classifyError(error: unknown): ProviderError {
  if (error instanceof ProviderError) {
    return error;
  }

  const record = asRecord(error);
  const message =
    error instanceof Error
      ? error.message
      : typeof error === "string"
        ? error
        : "Erro desconhecido.";

  const rawStatus =
    record?.status ?? record?.statusCode ?? record?.code ?? undefined;
  const status = typeof rawStatus === "number" ? rawStatus : undefined;
  const errName = typeof record?.name === "string" ? record.name : "";
  const errCode = typeof record?.code === "string" ? record.code : "";
  const retryAfterMs = parseRetryAfterMs(error, message);

  const looksDaily =
    /per.?day|daily|requests? per day|RPD|TPD|free-models-per-day/i.test(
      message
    );

  if (status === 402) {
    return new ProviderError(
      "quota_exhausted",
      "O provedor respondeu 402 (pagamento necessário). Use apenas modelos gratuitos e não adicione créditos.",
      { status }
    );
  }

  if (status === 429 || /RESOURCE_EXHAUSTED/i.test(message)) {
    return new ProviderError(
      looksDaily ? "quota_exhausted" : "rate_limit",
      message,
      { status: status ?? 429, retryAfterMs }
    );
  }

  if (status === 401 || status === 403) {
    return new ProviderError(
      "auth",
      `Chave recusada ou sem acesso a este modelo (HTTP ${status}). ${message}`,
      { status }
    );
  }

  if (status === 404 || (status === 400 && /model/i.test(message))) {
    return new ProviderError(
      "model",
      `Modelo indisponível ou nome inválido. ${message}`,
      { status }
    );
  }

  if (
    (status !== undefined && (status === 408 || status === 409 || status >= 500)) ||
    errName === "AbortError" ||
    errName === "APIConnectionError" ||
    errName === "APIConnectionTimeoutError" ||
    /ECONNRESET|ETIMEDOUT|ENOTFOUND|EAI_AGAIN|fetch failed|timeout|timed out/i.test(
      `${message} ${errCode}`
    )
  ) {
    return new ProviderError("transient", message, { status, retryAfterMs });
  }

  return new ProviderError("unknown", message, { status });
}

ARQUIVO: ./src/providers/usage-gate.ts
